papers.title: Once Generated, Ranked: End-to-End Generative Slate Recommendation with Unified Semantic-Collaborative IDs
papers.abstract: Slate recommendation treats a slate rather than an individual item as the recommendation unit, requiring joint optimization of item interactions and slate utility. Existing approaches typically separate candidate generation from ranking and restrict optimization to retrieved candidates. Generative recommendation with Semantic IDs (SIDs) offers a path to end-to-end recommendation, but existing SID construction often lacks recommendation-aware semantics and effective local collaborative signals, while next-token prediction is misaligned with slate-level objectives. We propose OGR, an end-to-end framework that directly generates ordered slates-"Once Generated, Ranked." OGR first introduces TUSID, which adaptively fuses item-specific semantic and local collaborative information into hierarchical SIDs. It then uses list-wise preference planning and pipelined position-wise SID decoding to model global preferences and inter-item dependencies while generating ordered slates. We further propose SPA, a reward-guided conservative policy optimization method that aligns generated slates with user preferences beyond likelihood imitation. Offline experiments show that OGR outperforms representative baselines, with 48.2% and 27.2% relative NDCG@5 gains on industrial and public datasets, respectively. Online A/B testing on Kuaishou further yields a 1.120% improvement in Effective Views.
papers.summary: 本文提出OGR框架，用于端到端生成式列表推荐。现有方法将候选生成与排序分离，且语义ID构建缺乏推荐感知和局部协同信号，下一token预测与列表级目标不对齐。OGR引入TUSID，融合语义和局部协同信息构建分层语义ID；采用列表级偏好规划和流水线位置解码生成有序列表；提出SPA策略优化方法，通过奖励引导保守优化，对齐生成列表与用户偏好。离线实验显示，OGR在工业数据集和公开数据集上NDCG@5相对提升48.2%和27.2%，在线A/B测试在快手平台有效观看提升1.120%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OGR通过统一语义协同ID和列表级生成策略，实现端到端有序列表推荐，显著提升推荐效果。
papers.core_method: TUSID（统一语义协同ID）构建分层ID，融合物品语义和局部协同信息；列表级偏好规划（list-wise preference planning）建模全局偏好；流水线位置解码（pipelined position-wise decoding）生成有序列表；SPA（保守策略优化）通过奖励引导优化生成列表。
innovation_points: 提出TUSID，自适应融合语义和局部协同信息，构建推荐感知的层次化语义ID。
采用列表级偏好规划和流水线位置解码，直接生成有序列表，对齐列表级目标。
提出SPA策略优化方法，通过奖励引导保守优化，缓解曝光偏差。
experiment_results: 离线实验：工业数据集NDCG@5相对提升48.2%，公开数据集提升27.2%。
在线A/B测试：快手平台有效观看提升1.120%。
limitations: 依赖语义ID的构建质量，可能受限于物品文本信息。
在线实验仅报告单一指标，未提供其他业务指标。
未讨论计算开销和推理延迟。
papers.practical_value: OGR可直接应用于工业推荐系统，实现端到端列表生成，减少级联误差，提升用户参与度，已在快手验证有效性。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决生成式推荐中语义ID构建和列表级目标对齐的关键问题，提供端到端生成列表的新范式，对推荐系统研究和工业实践均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: LLM-Based Generative Retrieval for Snapchat Content Recommendation
papers.abstract: Pretrained large language models (LLMs) are promising retrieval engines because they combine rich semantic priors, strong sequence modeling capabilities, and favorable scaling behavior. However, turning a pretrained LLM into a generative retriever in production deployment raises several challenges: the model must learn an internal item vocabulary that was absent from pretraining, and generate valid item identifiers under strict latency and cost constraints. We address these challenges through the design and launch of SnapLGR, an LLM-based generative retrieval system for short-video recommendation at Snapchat. The system is built around three main designs. First, we construct semantic identifiers (SIDs) from multimodal item embeddings and enhance them with Personalized PageRank (PPR)-based co-engagement contrastive learning, resulting in improved codebook utilization, reduced collisions, and infused collaborative signal. Second, we use continued pretraining (CPT) to ground the introduced SID tokens before supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on user interaction sequences. Third, we make SnapLGR serving practical through TensorRT-LLM CUDA-backed beam search and a decentralized worker-loop architecture. In a live A/B test, the launched system increased View Time by 0.37%, Time Spent by 0.09%, Deep Sessions by 0.18%, and Deep Sessions Unique User by 0.11% relative to the existing TIGER-style generative retrieval baseline. We then decompose this offline gap under a fixed tokenizer and quantify the gains due to model architecture, scaling, and pretraining. Overall, our deployment shows that successful production SnapLGR requires joint design across representation learning, vocabulary grounding, and efficient training and serving.
papers.summary: 本文介绍了SnapLGR，一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的生成式检索系统，用于Snapchat的短视频推荐。系统面临的主要挑战是LLM需要学习预训练中不存在的内部物品词汇，并在严格的延迟和成本约束下生成有效标识。为解决这些问题，作者设计了三个核心组件：基于多模态嵌入构建语义标识（SID），并通过个性化PageRank（PPR）协同对比学习增强，改善码本利用率和减少冲突；使用持续预训练（CPT）在监督微调（SFT）前对SID token进行接地；通过TensorRT-LLM CUDA支持的束搜索和去中心化工作循环架构实现高效服务。在线A/B测试显示，与TIGER风格基线相比，观看时间提升0.37%，花费时间提升0.09%，深度会话提升0.18%，深度会话独立用户提升0.11%。此外，作者在固定分词器下分解离线差距，量化了模型架构、规模和预训练的贡献。该部署表明，生产级SnapLGR需要联合设计表示学习、词汇接地和高效训练与服务。
papers.one_line_takeaway: SnapLGR通过语义标识、持续预训练和高效服务设计，成功将LLM生成式检索应用于Snapchat推荐，显著提升线上指标。
papers.core_method: 构建语义标识（SID）并利用PPR对比学习增强；使用持续预训练（CPT）接地SID token；采用TensorRT-LLM束搜索和去中心化工作循环架构进行高效服务。
innovation_points: 提出基于多模态嵌入和PPR对比学习的语义标识构建方法，提升码本利用率和协同信号。
在生成式检索中引入持续预训练（CPT）来接地新引入的SID token，改善模型适配。
设计生产级服务架构，利用TensorRT-LLM和去中心化工作循环满足严格延迟和成本约束。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试：观看时间+0.37%，花费时间+0.09%，深度会话+0.18%，深度会话独立用户+0.11%（相对TIGER基线）。
离线分解显示模型架构、规模和预训练对性能均有贡献，但具体数值未在摘要中给出。
limitations: 摘要未提供离线分解的具体数值，无法量化各组件贡献。
系统针对短视频推荐设计，可能不适用于其他物品类型或场景。
依赖多模态嵌入和PPR计算，可能增加工程复杂度。
papers.practical_value: 为LLM生成式检索在工业推荐系统中的落地提供了完整案例，包括语义标识设计、训练策略和服务优化，可直接借鉴于类似场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文是少数公开的LLM生成式检索生产部署案例，展示了从预训练模型到实际推荐系统的转化过程，解决了词汇学习、延迟约束等关键问题，对研究和工程均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Kimi K3: Open Frontier Intelligence
papers.abstract: We introduce Kimi K3, a 2.8T parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with 104 billion activated parameters, native vision capabilities, and a 1-million-token context window. Kimi K3 is built on Kimi Delta Attention and Attention Residuals, which improve information flow across sequence length and model depth. Together with Stable LatentMoE, which effectively activates 16 of 896 routed experts per token, and refined training and data recipes, these advances yield an approximately 2.5x improvement in overall scaling efficiency over Kimi K2. Post-training highlights reinforcement learning across general, agentic, and coding domains and multiple reasoning-effort levels, enabling compositional generalization and robust long-horizon execution. At 2.8T scale, Kimi K3 is supported by infrastructure advances in multiple areas: algorithm-system co-design for KDA, perfectly balanced expert-parallel training with efficient memory management, million-token agentic RL with persistent rollout and sandbox states, and deployment innovations. Extensive evaluations show that Kimi K3 achieves frontier-level performance across long-horizon coding, agentic, knowledge, reasoning, and vision tasks. While its overall performance still trails the most powerful proprietary models, namely Claude Fable 5 and GPT-5.6 Sol, Kimi K3 consistently outperforms other open and proprietary models evaluated in our suite. We release the full Kimi K3 model weights to facilitate future research and accelerate the broader deployment and adoption of frontier intelligence.
papers.summary: Kimi K3是Kimi团队发布的2.8T参数MoE模型，激活参数104B，具备原生视觉能力和1M上下文窗口。其核心创新包括Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals，改善序列长度和模型深度的信息流；Stable LatentMoE每token激活16个路由专家；训练和数据配方的优化使整体扩展效率较K2提升约2.5倍。后训练阶段在通用、智能体和编码领域进行强化学习，支持多种推理努力水平，实现组合泛化和长程执行。基础设施方面，算法-系统协同设计、专家并行训练、百万token智能体RL和部署创新支撑了模型规模。评估显示K3在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，虽仍落后于Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol，但优于其他开源和专有模型。模型权重已全面开源。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Kimi K3通过注意力机制和MoE架构创新，以2.8T参数实现前沿性能，并开源权重，推动开放前沿智能发展。
papers.core_method: Kimi K3采用MoE架构，结合Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals改进信息流，Stable LatentMoE实现高效专家路由，后训练使用多领域强化学习（通用、智能体、编码）和多种推理努力水平，基础设施上采用算法-系统协同设计、专家并行训练和百万token智能体RL。
innovation_points: Kimi Delta Attention和Attention Residuals：改善长序列和深层模型的信息流，提升扩展效率。
Stable LatentMoE：每token激活16个路由专家，平衡专家负载，提高训练稳定性。
多领域强化学习：覆盖通用、智能体和编码，支持多种推理努力水平，实现组合泛化。
基础设施创新：算法-系统协同设计、专家并行训练、百万token智能体RL和部署优化。
experiment_results: 整体扩展效率较K2提升约2.5倍。
在长程编码、智能体、知识、推理和视觉任务上达到前沿水平，优于其他开源和专有模型（除Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol）。
具体基准分数未在摘要中提供。
limitations: 整体性能仍落后于最强大的专有模型（Claude Fable 5和GPT-5.6 Sol）。
摘要未提供详细基准分数，难以量化具体差距。
2.8T参数规模可能带来部署和推理成本挑战。
papers.practical_value: Kimi K3开源权重，可加速研究社区和企业的部署，其长上下文和视觉能力适用于复杂智能体任务，如长程编码和自动化工作流，基础设施创新为大规模模型训练和推理提供参考。
papers.why_it_matters: Kimi K3展示了开源模型在规模和技术创新上的突破，其注意力机制和MoE优化为后续研究提供新方向，同时开源策略推动前沿智能的民主化，值得关注其技术细节和实际效果。

papers.title: OxygenREC-v2: Internalizing Discrimination into Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation unifies retrieval and ranking within a single model by autoregressively decoding semantic identifier (SID) sequences. Yet reliably incorporating behavior signals from clicks, cart additions, and orders remains challenging. Existing approaches either jointly optimize generative and discriminative objectives, requiring delicate trade-offs, or use a separate ranker as a post-hoc reinforcement-learning reward, risking out-of-distribution scoring and reward misalignment. We propose OxygenREC-v2, a generative recommender that Internalizes Discrimination into Generative Recommendation (IDGR). Rather than adding a separate discriminative objective, OxygenREC-v2 uses logged behavior to condition generation and supervise training. During pre-training, a behavior instruction conditions generation on the target behavior. During post-training, future interaction behaviors are exploited as privileged knowledge in our entropy-aware trajectory optimization self-distillation framework, enabling reward-model-free policy optimization. Throughout both training stages, OxygenREC-v2 maintains a single unified backbone. We implement OxygenREC-v2 as a 3B-parameter, 1B-activated MoE and deploy it on JD.com's large-scale e-commerce platform. Across multiple online A/B tests, OxygenREC-v2 improves user click-through conversion rate (UCTCVR) by 1.6--4.4% and GMV by 2.8--6.8% over OxygenREC-v1.
papers.summary: OxygenREC-v2提出了一种将判别式行为信号内化到生成式推荐中的方法（IDGR），以解决现有方法在联合优化生成与判别目标时需权衡、或使用独立排序器作为强化学习奖励导致分布外评分和奖励错位的问题。该方法在预训练阶段通过行为指令条件化生成，在后训练阶段利用未来交互行为作为特权知识，通过熵感知轨迹优化自蒸馏框架实现无奖励模型的策略优化，全程保持单一统一骨干网络。模型为3B参数、1B激活的MoE架构，已在京东大规模电商平台部署。在线A/B测试显示，相比OxygenREC-v1，用户点击转化率（UCTCVR）提升1.6%-4.4%，GMV提升2.8%-6.8%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OxygenREC-v2通过行为指令和特权知识蒸馏，将判别信号内化到生成式推荐中，实现了单一模型下的高效在线部署和显著业务提升。
papers.core_method: IDGR框架：预训练阶段使用行为指令（如点击、加购、下单）条件化生成；后训练阶段利用未来交互行为作为特权知识，通过熵感知轨迹优化自蒸馏进行策略优化，无需奖励模型。
innovation_points: 提出行为指令条件化生成，将行为信号直接融入预训练，避免额外判别目标。
利用特权知识进行自蒸馏，实现无奖励模型的策略优化，减少分布外风险。
采用熵感知轨迹优化，平衡探索与利用，提升策略稳定性。
保持单一统一骨干网络，简化部署并降低推理成本。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试中，UCTCVR提升1.6%-4.4%，GMV提升2.8%-6.8%（对比OxygenREC-v1）。
未提供离线实验数据或消融实验细节。
limitations: 依赖历史行为日志，冷启动场景可能受限。
特权知识蒸馏可能引入信息泄漏风险，需谨慎处理。
未公开离线评估指标，难以独立验证模型效果。
papers.practical_value: 在京东电商平台成功部署，显著提升点击转化率和GMV，验证了生成式推荐在真实业务场景中的可行性和商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了生成式推荐中行为信号融合的难题，提出了一种无需额外判别模型或奖励模型的统一框架，为工业界大规模部署生成式推荐提供了新思路。

papers.title: Guess Where You Go: Generative Next Point-of-Interest Recommendation in Amap
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval enables recommender systems to retrieve items by generating compact item identifiers, but scaling it to industrial scenarios remains challenging due to redundant or colliding token assignments and insufficient integration of heterogeneous item signals. These challenges are particularly critical for next Point-of-Interest (POI) recommendation, where models must represent structured spatial entities, capture sequential mobility patterns, and produce predictions consistent with real user behavior. We propose Gwhere, an end-to-end industrial framework that integrates semantic identifier (SID) generation with LLM-based generative next POI recommendation. Gwhere first learns discriminative POI SIDs through a contrastive residual-quantization tokenizer that aligns textual, visual, spatial, and collaborative signals. Based on these SIDs, Gwhere adapts LLMs to mobility scenarios via continued pretraining on enriched spatio-temporal corpora, supervised fine-tuning, and Exposure-Aware Kahneman-Tversky Optimization (EAKTO), a reinforcement learning objective for behavioral preference alignment. Experiments on public datasets and Amap's large-scale industrial dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of Gwhere. The system has been deployed in Amap's homepage service under high-concurrency and low-latency constraints. Long-term online A/B tests show improvements of 5.83% in P-CTR and 6.20% in U-CTR over the production baseline. The implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/alibaba/SimCIT.
papers.summary: Gwhere是阿里巴巴高德地图提出的端到端工业级生成式下一兴趣点（POI）推荐框架，旨在解决生成式检索在工业场景中面临的token分配冗余/冲突以及异构信号融合不足等问题。该框架首先通过对比残差量化分词器学习判别性POI语义ID（SID），该分词器对齐文本、视觉、空间和协同信号；然后基于SID，通过丰富时空语料上的持续预训练、监督微调和暴露感知的Kahneman-Tversky优化（EAKTO）将LLM适配到移动场景。在公共数据集和高德大规模工业数据集上的实验验证了有效性，系统已部署在高德首页服务中，长期在线A/B测试显示P-CTR提升5.83%，U-CTR提升6.20%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Gwhere通过语义ID生成和LLM微调，实现了工业级生成式POI推荐，显著提升线上点击率。
papers.core_method: Gwhere包含两个核心组件：1）对比残差量化分词器，学习融合多模态信号的POI语义ID；2）基于LLM的生成式推荐，通过持续预训练、监督微调和EAKTO对齐用户行为偏好。
innovation_points: 提出对比残差量化分词器，生成判别性语义ID，解决token分配冗余和冲突问题
将LLM适配到移动场景，通过持续预训练和EAKTO对齐行为偏好
在工业级高并发低延迟环境下成功部署，验证了生成式推荐的实用性
experiment_results: 公共数据集和高德工业数据集上，Gwhere优于基线模型
长期在线A/B测试显示P-CTR提升5.83%，U-CTR提升6.20%
limitations: 依赖高质量的多模态数据，数据缺失可能影响SID质量
LLM推理成本较高，需优化以满足低延迟要求
EAKTO的奖励模型设计可能需针对不同场景调整
papers.practical_value: Gwhere已部署在高德首页，证明了生成式推荐在真实工业场景中的可行性，为其他地图或基于位置的推荐系统提供了参考。
papers.why_it_matters: 该研究解决了生成式推荐在工业落地中的关键挑战，展示了LLM在结构化空间实体建模中的潜力，对推荐系统领域具有重要启发。

papers.title: DOS: Dual-Flow Orthogonal Semantic IDs for Recommendation in Meituan
papers.abstract: Semantic IDs serve as a key component in generative recommendation systems. They not only incorporate open-world knowledge from large language models (LLMs) but also compress the semantic space to reduce generation difficulty. However, existing methods suffer from two major limitations: (1) the lack of contextual awareness in generation tasks leads to a gap between the Semantic ID codebook space and the generation space, resulting in suboptimal recommendations; and (2) suboptimal quantization methods exacerbate semantic loss in LLMs. To address these issues, we propose Dual-Flow Orthogonal Semantic IDs (DOS) method. Specifically, DOS employs a user-item dual flow-framework that leverages collaborative signals to align the Semantic ID codebook space with the generation space. Furthermore, we introduce an orthogonal residual quantization scheme that rotates the semantic space to an appropriate orientation, thereby maximizing semantic preservation. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing demonstrate the effectiveness of DOS. The proposed method has been successfully deployed in Meituan's mobile application, serving hundreds of millions of users.
papers.summary: 本文提出DOS方法，用于美团生成式推荐中的语义ID构建。现有语义ID方法存在生成任务缺乏上下文感知导致码本空间与生成空间不一致，以及量化方法不佳造成语义损失的问题。DOS采用用户-物品双流框架，利用协同信号对齐语义ID码本空间与生成空间；并引入正交残差量化方案，旋转语义空间以最大化语义保留。离线实验和在线A/B测试表明DOS有效，已在美团APP部署，服务数亿用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过双流框架和正交残差量化，DOS有效对齐语义ID码本与生成空间，提升生成式推荐性能并成功落地于美团。

papers.title: S$^2$GR: Stepwise Semantic-Guided Reasoning in Latent Space for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative Recommendation (GR) has emerged as a transformative paradigm with its end-to-end generation advantages. However, existing GR methods primarily focus on direct Semantic ID (SID) generation from interaction sequences, failing to activate deeper reasoning capabilities analogous to those in large language models and thus limiting performance potential. We identify two critical limitations in current reasoning-enhanced GR approaches: (1) Strict sequential separation between reasoning and generation steps creates imbalanced computational focus across hierarchical SID codes, degrading quality for SID codes; (2) Generated reasoning vectors lack interpretable semantics, while reasoning paths suffer from unverifiable supervision. In this paper, we propose stepwise semantic-guided reasoning in latent space (S$^2$GR), a novel reasoning enhanced GR framework. First, we establish a robust semantic foundation via codebook optimization, integrating item co-occurrence relationship to capture behavioral patterns, and load balancing and uniformity objectives that maximize codebook utilization while reinforcing coarse-to-fine semantic hierarchies. Our core innovation introduces the stepwise reasoning mechanism inserting thinking tokens before each SID generation step, where each token explicitly represents coarse-grained semantics supervised via contrastive learning against ground-truth codebook cluster distributions ensuring physically grounded reasoning paths and balanced computational focus across all SID codes. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of S$^2$GR, and online A/B test confirms efficacy on large-scale industrial short video platform.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐（GR）通过端到端生成语义ID（SID）展现潜力，但现有方法缺乏深层推理能力，且推理增强方法存在计算不均衡和推理路径不可解释的问题。本文提出S²GR框架，在潜在空间中进行逐步语义引导推理。首先通过码本优化（整合物品共现、负载均衡和均匀性目标）建立稳健的语义基础；核心创新是在每个SID生成步骤前插入思维令牌，每个令牌通过对比学习显式表示粗粒度语义，监督信号来自真实码本聚类分布，确保推理路径有物理依据且计算均衡。实验表明S²GR在多个数据集上优于基线，并在大规模工业短视频平台上的在线A/B测试中验证了有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: S²GR通过在潜在空间中逐步插入语义引导的思维令牌，实现了可解释且计算均衡的生成式推荐推理，显著提升推荐性能。
papers.core_method: S²GR框架：1) 码本优化：结合物品共现关系、负载均衡和均匀性目标，强化粗到细的语义层次；2) 逐步推理：在每个SID生成步骤前插入思维令牌，每个令牌通过对比学习与真实码本聚类分布对齐，显式表示粗粒度语义，引导后续生成。
innovation_points: 提出逐步语义引导推理机制，在每个SID生成步骤前插入思维令牌，实现计算均衡和可解释的推理路径。
通过对比学习将思维令牌与真实码本聚类分布对齐，确保推理路径有物理依据且可验证。
码本优化整合物品共现关系、负载均衡和均匀性目标，提升码本利用率和语义层次。
experiment_results: 在多个公开数据集上，S²GR优于现有生成式推荐基线（具体数值未在摘要中给出）。
在线A/B测试在大型工业短视频平台上验证了有效性（具体提升指标未在摘要中给出）。
