papers.title: Adaptive Loss Balancing for Noise-Robust GRPO in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) presents a promising avenue for enhancing generative recommendation beyond supervised imitation, leveraging reward signals to guide policy improvement. However, its efficacy is critically contingent on the trustworthiness of the reward model for the samples it evaluates. In practice, production rankers, the widely adopted reward models, are trained on exposure-biased logs, leading to sample-dependent inaccuracies that violate this assumption. Our stratified analysis uncovers a consistent pattern: reward guidance is most beneficial when the policy exhibits uncertainty and the ranker can effectively discriminate the ground-truth item from rollout negatives. On other samples, the reward signal is either negligible or detrimental, highlighting the risk of uniform RL application. To address such an issue, we introduce AdaGRPO, a novel framework that treats reward-guided optimization as selective admission rather than uniform pressure. Training is anchored in supervised negative log-likelihood, while the GRPO objective is gated by a binary, per-sample clip determined by two rollout diagnostics: policy-side difficulty and reward discriminability. Instances failing either diagnostic default to pure supervision, ensuring stability and mitigating the amplification of noisy gradients. We validate AdaGRPO on a large-scale e-commerce dataset. At the best intermediate checkpoint, it elevates HR@10 from 11.01% to 12.18% while constraining hallucination below 0.22%, and maintains robustness at the final checkpoint (HR@10 11.63%, hallucination 0.27%), outperforming fixed NLL--GRPO mixtures across the retrieval--validity frontier. In production A/B tests, AdaGRPO achieves statistically significant gains in click-through rate and dwell time, confirming its practical utility.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式推荐中强化学习（RL）因奖励模型不可靠而失效的问题，提出AdaGRPO框架。通过分层分析发现，奖励引导仅在策略不确定且排序器能有效区分真实项与负样本时有益，否则有害。AdaGRPO以监督负对数似然（NLL）为锚，用策略难度和奖励可区分性两个诊断指标决定每个样本是否应用GRPO目标，不满足条件的样本仅用监督学习。在大型电商数据集上，最佳中间检查点HR@10从11.01%提升至12.18%，幻觉率低于0.22%；最终检查点HR@10为11.63%，幻觉率0.27%，优于固定NLL-GRPO混合。线上A/B测试显示点击率和停留时间显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AdaGRPO通过选择性应用GRPO，仅在奖励可靠时使用强化学习，显著提升生成式推荐的检索准确性和有效性。
papers.core_method: AdaGRPO框架：以监督NLL为训练基础，对每个样本计算两个诊断指标（策略侧难度和奖励可区分性），据此决定是否应用GRPO目标。若任一指标不达标，则跳过GRPO，仅用监督损失，从而避免噪声梯度放大。
innovation_points: 提出分层分析揭示奖励引导的适用条件：仅在策略不确定且排序器可区分时有效。

在离线评估和线上A/B测试中验证了方法在检索-有效性前沿上的优势。
experiment_results: 离线：最佳中间检查点HR@10从11.01%提升至12.18%，幻觉率低于0.22%；最终检查点HR@10为11.63%，幻觉率0.27%。
线上A/B测试：点击率和停留时间有统计显著提升。
limitations: 依赖两个诊断指标的计算，可能增加训练开销。

papers.title: S-GRec: Personalized Semantic-Aware Generative Recommendation with Asymmetric Advantage
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation models sequence generation to produce items end-to-end, but training from behavioral logs often provides weak supervision on underlying user intent. Although Large Language Models (LLMs) offer rich semantic priors that could supply such supervision, direct adoption in industrial recommendation is hindered by two obstacles: semantic signals can conflict with platform business objectives, and LLM inference is prohibitively expensive at scale. This paper presents S-GRec, a semantic-aware framework that decouples an online lightweight generator from an offline LLM-based semantic judge for train-time supervision. S-GRec introduces a two-stage Personalized Semantic Judge (PSJ) that produces interpretable aspect evidence and learns user-conditional aggregation from pairwise feedback, yielding stable semantic rewards. To prevent semantic supervision from deviating from business goals, Asymmetric Advantage Policy Optimization (A2PO) anchors optimization on business rewards (e.g., eCPM) and injects semantic advantages only when they are consistent. Extensive experiments on public benchmarks and a large-scale production system validate both effectiveness and scalability, including statistically significant gains in CTR and a 1.19\% lift in GMV in online A/B tests, without requiring real-time LLM inference.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐通过序列生成端到端产出物品，但行为日志训练对用户潜在意图的监督较弱。大语言模型（LLM）提供丰富语义先验，但直接用于工业推荐面临语义信号与业务目标冲突、LLM推理成本过高等障碍。本文提出S-GRec，一种语义感知框架，将在线轻量生成器与离线基于LLM的语义评判器解耦，用于训练时监督。S-GRec引入两阶段个性化语义评判器（PSJ），生成可解释的方面证据，并通过成对反馈学习用户条件聚合，产生稳定的语义奖励。为防止语义监督偏离业务目标，非对称优势策略优化（A2PO）将优化锚定在业务奖励（如eCPM）上，仅在语义优势与业务一致时注入。在公开基准和大型生产系统上的实验验证了有效性和可扩展性，包括CTR的统计显著提升和在线A/B测试中GMV提升1.19%，且无需实时LLM推理。
papers.one_line_takeaway: S-GRec通过离线LLM语义评判器提供训练时监督，并用非对称优势策略优化确保语义信号不偏离业务目标，实现无需实时LLM推理的生成式推荐提升。
papers.core_method: S-GRec框架：1) 两阶段个性化语义评判器（PSJ），第一阶段生成可解释的方面证据，第二阶段从成对反馈中学习用户条件聚合，产生稳定语义奖励；2) 非对称优势策略优化（A2PO），以业务奖励（如eCPM）为锚，仅当语义优势与业务一致时注入，防止语义偏离业务目标。

两阶段个性化语义评判器（PSJ）生成可解释方面证据并学习用户条件聚合，提供稳定语义奖励
非对称优势策略优化（A2PO）锚定业务奖励，仅注入一致的语义优势，确保业务目标优先

在大型生产系统中，在线A/B测试显示CTR有统计显著提升

papers.practical_value: S-GRec为工业推荐提供了一种可行方案：利用LLM语义知识增强生成式推荐，同时避免高成本在线推理，并通过A2PO确保业务目标（如GMV）不因语义优化而受损，适合部署于大规模生产系统。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式推荐中语义监督与业务目标冲突、LLM推理成本高的核心问题，提出解耦训练框架和策略优化方法，在真实生产系统中验证了价值，对工业界和学术界均有重要参考意义。

papers.title: FlashTrie: A GPU-Accelerated Constrained Beam Search for Generative Retrieval
papers.abstract: Constrained decoding is essential in generative retrieval, where document identifiers generated directly from a query must exactly match a predefined library of valid IDs. At scale, decoding is often constrained using a trie with beam search but most implementations run on CPU. Limited parallelism then makes trie traversal and candidate validation a serving bottleneck as beam width grows. We present FlashTrie, which addresses this limitation by optimizing constrained beam search on GPUs. It introduces an integer-aware succinct trie layout that uses bit compression to reduce memory footprint while keeping the full index in GPU high-bandwidth memory reducing memory stalls, and a cooperative CUDA kernel that performs beam expansion, validation, and pruning entirely on-device without per-step host orchestration. It further replaces CPU-style irregular lookup and heap maintenance with GPU-aware parallel primitives, improving warp utilization and reducing divergence. Together, these designs significantly reduce decoding latency and increase throughput while preserving retrieval quality. On a library of 800M keywords with beam widths up to 1000, FlashTrie reduces trie-search latency to under 3 ms, achieving up to 24x speedup over a highly optimized multi-threaded CPU baseline. These improvements enable FlashTrie to scale beam sizes by up to 5x in latency-critical applications such as sponsored search. In a large-scale online A/B experiment on a popular commercial search engine, it delivers a statistically significant +0.71% revenue lift, enabling real-time constrained decoding at a scale previously feasible only offline. The FlashTrie code will be publicly released after the review process.
papers.summary: FlashTrie提出了一种面向生成式检索的GPU加速约束波束搜索方法。生成式检索中，模型需直接生成与预定义文档标识符库精确匹配的ID，通常使用基于trie的约束解码，但现有实现多在CPU上运行，导致波束宽度增大时成为服务瓶颈。FlashTrie通过整数感知的紧凑trie布局（位压缩）将完整索引驻留于GPU高带宽内存，减少内存停顿；并设计协作式CUDA内核，在设备端完成波束扩展、验证和剪枝，无需主机逐步骤协调。同时，用GPU并行原语替代CPU式不规则查找和堆维护，提升warp利用率并减少发散。在800M关键词库、波束宽度达1000时，trie搜索延迟降至3毫秒以下，相比多线程CPU基线实现最高24倍加速，并支持波束规模扩大5倍。在大型商业搜索引擎的在线A/B实验中，实现了统计显著的+0.71%收入提升，使实时约束解码达到此前仅离线可行的规模。代码将在评审后公开。
papers.one_line_takeaway: FlashTrie通过GPU优化的紧凑trie布局和协作内核，将生成式检索的约束波束搜索延迟降低至毫秒级，并带来显著在线收益。
papers.core_method: FlashTrie的核心方法包括：1) 整数感知的紧凑trie布局，利用位压缩减少内存占用，使完整索引驻留于GPU高带宽内存；2) 协作式CUDA内核，在设备端完成波束扩展、验证和剪枝，消除主机逐步骤协调；3) 用GPU并行原语替代CPU式不规则查找和堆维护，提升warp利用率并减少发散。
innovation_points: 提出整数感知的紧凑trie布局，通过位压缩显著降低内存占用，使大规模索引可完全驻留于GPU高带宽内存。
设计协作式CUDA内核，实现波束扩展、验证和剪枝的全设备端处理，避免主机-设备间频繁通信。
用GPU并行原语替代CPU式堆维护和查找，改善warp利用率并减少线程发散。
experiment_results: 在800M关键词库、波束宽度达1000时，trie搜索延迟降至3毫秒以下，相比多线程CPU基线实现最高24倍加速。
支持波束规模扩大5倍，适用于延迟敏感场景如赞助搜索。
在大型商业搜索引擎的在线A/B实验中，实现统计显著的+0.71%收入提升。
limitations: 论文未提供与GPU上其他约束解码方法的对比，如基于GPU的beam search实现。
未讨论内存占用与波束宽度、关键词库大小的扩展性关系，可能受限于GPU内存容量。
在线实验仅报告收入提升，未提供检索质量指标（如NDCG）的详细变化。
papers.practical_value: FlashTrie使生成式检索的约束解码能够实时运行，支持更大波束宽度，提升检索质量，并在商业搜索引擎中带来收入增长。其GPU优化设计可直接应用于工业级检索系统，降低延迟和成本。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文解决了生成式检索中约束解码的工程瓶颈，展示了GPU优化在推理系统中的关键作用。其方法具有通用性，可推广到其他需要约束解码的生成任务，为大规模部署生成式模型提供了实践指导。

papers.title: Recommendation as Generation: Unifying Personalized Video Generation and Recommendation at Industrial Scale
papers.abstract: Traditional short-video recommendation systems match user interest to a fixed pool of pre-produced videos, which limits their ability to capture fine-grained and dynamic preferences. We propose Recommendation-as-Generation (RaG), a new paradigm that generates personalized videos on demand from inferred user interest. Our framework unifies generative recommendation and video generation through shared semantic IDs (SIDs), which disentangle video representation into content semantics and creative style semantics, enabling both fine-grained modeling of user interest and controllable generation of interest-aligned videos. We further develop Video Generation Agents (VGAs) that are conditioned on inferred SIDs to drive hierarchical planning and refinement for video creation, including visual composition, audio alignment, and artistic effect enhancement. To optimize the framework, we effectively introduce a synergistic cross-domain reward learning mechanism that jointly enforces interest alignment, user feedback, and video quality assessment. We deploy RaG on an industrial-scale platform with over 400 million daily active users and evaluate it in a revenue-critical advertising scenario. Online A/B tests show up to 1.87% ad revenue improvement compared to a strong production GRM baseline, demonstrating its effectiveness in driving further revenue gains beyond generative recommendation. Our results highlight a closed-loop generative system as a promising paradigm for integrating personalized video generation into recommendation.
papers.summary: 本文提出推荐即生成（RaG）范式，将个性化视频生成与推荐系统统一于工业规模平台。传统短视频推荐仅匹配预生成视频，难以捕捉细粒度动态偏好。RaG通过共享语义ID（SIDs）解耦视频内容语义与创意风格语义，实现用户兴趣精细建模与可控视频生成。系统采用视频生成智能体（VGAs），基于推断的SIDs进行分层规划与细化，涵盖视觉构图、音频对齐和艺术效果增强。优化上引入跨域奖励学习机制，联合强化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量评估。在日活超4亿的工业平台广告场景中部署，在线A/B测试显示广告收入提升1.87%，优于强生产基线GRM，验证了闭环生成系统的有效性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RaG通过共享语义ID统一生成式推荐与视频生成，在工业规模广告场景中显著提升收入，展示了闭环生成系统的潜力。
papers.core_method: 共享语义ID（SIDs）解耦视频内容与风格，视频生成智能体（VGAs）基于SIDs分层规划生成，跨域奖励学习联合优化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量。
innovation_points: 提出RaG范式，将推荐从匹配固定视频池转变为按需生成个性化视频。
引入共享语义ID（SIDs），统一生成式推荐与视频生成，实现可控生成。
开发视频生成智能体（VGAs），支持分层规划与多维度细化。
设计跨域奖励学习机制，协同优化兴趣对齐、用户反馈与视频质量。
experiment_results: 在线A/B测试显示广告收入提升1.87%，相比强生产GRM基线。
系统部署于日活超4亿的工业平台，验证了可扩展性。
limitations: 论文未提供离线评估细节，如生成视频质量的具体指标。
依赖大规模基础设施，可能不适用于中小型平台。
未讨论生成视频的伦理与安全风险。
papers.practical_value: RaG在真实广告场景中带来显著收入提升，为推荐系统与内容生成的融合提供了可落地方案，对短视频平台具有直接商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文首次在工业规模验证了生成式推荐与视频生成的闭环，突破了传统推荐边界，为未来个性化内容生成提供了新范式，值得关注其技术架构与工程实现。

papers.title: Gryphon: A Unified Architecture for Semantic-ID Generation and Item-Level Scoring in Industrial Recommendations
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval (GR) has become a scalable approach to candidate generation: each item is assigned a short hierarchical token sequence called a Semantic ID (SID), and the next item's SID is decoded autoregressively. A practical limitation is that the decoder's beam search optimizes the likelihood of token sequences, not the relevance of the underlying items. These objectives diverge when sequence likelihood is poorly calibrated due to beam search error accumulation, and when several items collapse onto a single SID and receive identical scores. We introduce Gryphon, an encoder-decoder generative recommendation architecture that adds a jointly trained item-level scoring component alongside SID generation, reusing the encoder's user representation computed in a single forward pass. Instead of ranking SIDs by accumulated token likelihood, Gryphon resolves each generated SID to its concrete items and re-scores those items directly, which sidesteps miscalibrated sequence scores and separates items that collide on the same identifier. On an industrial music service, with item-level scoring trained under a next-item-prediction objective, Gryphon attains the highest item-level Recall@1000, above the strongest baselines (+3.7% over vanilla GR and +2.5% over collision-resolved GR) at comparable parameter count and latency. Gryphon's item-level ranking also surpasses its beam-likelihood ranking of the same candidates (+4.2% gain), demonstrating the benefit of item-level scoring in GR. Deployed as the sole candidate source in a 7-day A/B test, Gryphon produced no statistically significant change in total listening time (+0.25%) while replacing a pipeline of more than 15 candidate generators and a separate preranking stage, substantially simplifying the candidate-generation system.
papers.summary: Gryphon提出了一种统一的编码器-解码器生成式推荐架构，在工业推荐系统中同时进行语义ID生成和物品级评分。针对生成式检索中解码器束搜索优化序列似然而非物品相关性的问题，以及多个物品共享同一语义ID导致评分相同的问题，Gryphon在生成语义ID的同时，利用编码器单次前向计算得到的用户表示，对生成的语义ID解析出的具体物品进行直接重评分。在工业音乐服务上，采用下一项预测目标训练物品级评分，Gryphon在物品级Recall@1000上达到最高，比最强基线（vanilla GR和collision-resolved GR）分别提升3.7%和2.5%，参数和延迟相当。Gryphon的物品级排序比同一候选集的束似然排序提升4.2%。在7天A/B测试中，作为唯一候选源，Gryphon替代了超过15个候选生成器和独立预排序阶段，总收听时间无显著变化（+0.25%），大幅简化了候选生成系统。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Gryphon通过联合训练物品级评分组件，直接对生成的语义ID解析出的物品进行重排序，解决了生成式推荐中序列似然与物品相关性目标不一致及语义ID碰撞问题，在工业规模上提升了召回率并简化了系统。
papers.core_method: Gryphon采用编码器-解码器架构，编码器生成用户表示，解码器自回归生成语义ID序列。在训练时，除了标准的序列生成损失，还联合训练一个物品级评分头，该评分头复用编码器的用户表示，对每个生成的语义ID对应的具体物品进行评分。推理时，解码器通过束搜索生成候选语义ID，然后解析出所有对应物品，用物品级评分头重新排序，而不是使用束搜索的累积似然。
innovation_points: 提出联合训练的物品级评分组件，与语义ID生成共享编码器表示，实现单次前向计算。
推理时直接对解析出的物品进行重评分，避免序列似然校准不良和束搜索误差累积。
解决语义ID碰撞问题，使共享同一ID的物品获得不同分数。
在工业规模上验证，可替代多候选生成器和预排序阶段，简化系统架构。
experiment_results: 物品级Recall@1000：Gryphon比vanilla GR提升3.7%，比collision-resolved GR提升2.5%，参数和延迟相当。
Gryphon的物品级排序比同一候选集的束似然排序提升4.2%。
7天A/B测试：作为唯一候选源，总收听时间变化+0.25%，无统计显著差异，替代了15+候选生成器和预排序阶段。
limitations: 物品级评分仅针对解码器生成的候选集，可能受限于束搜索的候选质量。
实验仅在音乐服务场景验证，其他领域泛化性未知。
A/B测试中总收听时间无显著提升，可能未充分体现推荐质量改进。
papers.practical_value: Gryphon在工业推荐系统中可直接部署，替代复杂的多候选生成器和预排序流水线，简化系统维护和计算成本，同时保持或略微提升核心业务指标（如收听时间），为生成式推荐在真实场景中的落地提供了可行方案。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐的核心缺陷（序列似然与物品相关性目标不一致、语义ID碰撞）提出了实用的解决方案，并在工业规模上验证了其有效性，对生成式推荐在工业界的应用具有重要参考价值。

papers.title: Gryphon-v2: One Model in Place of a Cascade - Generate-and-Rank Recommender with Rollout Distillation
papers.abstract: Industrial recommender systems are commonly deployed as multi-stage cascades with separate candidate generators, pre-rankers, and final rankers. Although effective, these cascades require repeated user-history processing, complex feature pipelines, and multiple serving stages. Semantic-ID-based generative retrieval offers a path toward simpler end-to-end systems, but next-item prediction alone does not capture the fine-grained preferences encoded by production ranking objectives. We present Gryphon-v2, a unified generate-and-rank architecture for end-to-end recommendation. The model encodes a user history once, generates Semantic-ID candidates with an autoregressive decoder, resolves them to catalogue items, and ranks them with an item-level Ranking Module that reuses the shared encoder states. To transfer fine-grained production ranking preferences without adding an expensive second model to the serving path, we distill a high-capacity, training-only Teacher Ranker into the Ranking Module. Gryphon-v2 is trained with Rollout Distillation: teacher scores are the only ranking supervision, and they are collected over two complementary candidate distributions. Rollouts from the current decoder expose the Ranking Module to candidates produced by the same generation mechanism used at serving time, while logged impressions cover items users were actually shown. In an online A/B experiment on a large-scale recommendation surface at Yandex Music, a single Gryphon-v2 model replaces a production cascade comprising more than 15 candidate generators, pre-ranking, and final ranking. The deployment increases the number of active users by 1.41% at serving latency comparable to the production cascade. These results support the practical viability of a generative retriever with a Ranking Module distilled from the Teacher Ranker as an end-to-end alternative to a production cascade.
papers.summary: 工业推荐系统通常部署为多阶段级联，包含候选生成器、预排序器和最终排序器，虽有效但需重复处理用户历史、复杂特征管道和多个服务阶段。基于语义ID的生成式检索提供了更简单的端到端路径，但仅预测下一项无法捕捉生产排序目标的细粒度偏好。Gryphon-v2提出统一的生成-排序架构，编码用户历史一次，用自回归解码器生成语义ID候选，解析为目录项，并通过共享编码器状态的物品级排序模块进行排序。为转移细粒度生产排序偏好而不增加服务端第二模型，将高容量、仅训练的教师排序器蒸馏到排序模块。训练采用Rollout Distillation，教师分数是唯一排序监督，在两种互补候选分布上收集：当前解码器的rollout暴露生成机制产生的候选，日志曝光覆盖用户实际看到的物品。在Yandex Music的大规模推荐表面在线A/B实验中，单个Gryphon-v2模型替代了包含超过15个候选生成器、预排序和最终排序的生产级联，活跃用户数增加1.41%，服务延迟与生产级联相当。结果支持生成式检索器与从教师排序器蒸馏的排序模块作为生产级联端到端替代方案的实践可行性。
papers.one_line_takeaway: Gryphon-v2用单一生成-排序模型替代生产级联，通过Rollout Distillation蒸馏教师排序器，在保持延迟的同时提升活跃用户数。
papers.core_method: Gryphon-v2架构：用户历史编码一次，自回归解码器生成语义ID候选，排序模块复用编码器状态进行物品级排序。训练采用Rollout Distillation，教师排序器（仅训练）提供排序分数作为唯一监督，在解码器rollout和日志曝光两种候选分布上收集。
innovation_points: 统一生成-排序架构，单模型替代多阶段级联，减少服务阶段和特征管道。
Rollout Distillation：从高容量教师排序器蒸馏到排序模块，无需额外服务模型。

papers.title: From Relevance to Authority: Authority-aware Generative Retrieval in Web Search Engines
papers.abstract: Generative information retrieval (GenIR) formulates the retrieval process as a text-to-text generation task, leveraging the vast knowledge of large language models. However, existing works primarily optimize for relevance while often overlooking document trustworthiness. This is critical in high-stakes domains like healthcare and finance, where relying solely on semantic relevance risks retrieving unreliable information. To address this, we propose an Authority-aware Generative Retriever (AuthGR), the first framework that incorporates authority into GenIR. AuthGR consists of three key components: (i) Multimodal Authority Scoring, which employs a vision-language model to quantify authority from textual and visual cues; (ii) a Three-stage Training Pipeline to progressively instill authority awareness into the retriever; and (iii) a Hybrid Ensemble Pipeline for robust deployment. Offline evaluations demonstrate that AuthGR successfully enhances both authority and accuracy, with our 3B model matching a 14B baseline. Crucially, large-scale online A/B tests and human evaluations conducted on the commercial web search platform confirm significant improvements in real-world user engagement and reliability.
papers.summary: 本文提出AuthGR，首个将权威性纳入生成式检索（GenIR）的框架。现有GenIR主要优化相关性，忽略文档可信度，在医疗、金融等高风险场景中可能检索到不可靠信息。AuthGR包含三个关键组件：多模态权威评分（利用视觉语言模型从文本和视觉线索量化权威性）、三阶段训练流程（逐步将权威意识注入检索器）和混合集成流程（用于稳健部署）。离线评估显示，AuthGR在提升权威性和准确性的同时，3B模型性能可与14B基线匹敌。在商业搜索引擎上的大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估证实了其在真实用户参与度和可靠性方面的显著提升。
papers.one_line_takeaway: AuthGR通过多模态权威评分和三阶段训练，在生成式检索中同时优化相关性和权威性，并在商业搜索引擎中验证了实际效果。
papers.core_method: AuthGR框架：1）多模态权威评分，使用视觉语言模型（VLM）从文本和视觉线索（如页面布局、图片）量化文档权威性；2）三阶段训练流程，逐步将权威性信号融入生成式检索器；3）混合集成流程，结合多个模型或策略以提升部署鲁棒性。
innovation_points: 首次将权威性显式纳入生成式检索（GenIR）框架，解决仅优化相关性导致的可信度问题。
提出多模态权威评分方法，利用视觉语言模型同时处理文本和视觉线索，更全面地评估文档权威性。
设计三阶段训练流程，渐进式地让检索器学习权威性，避免直接联合训练可能带来的不稳定。
在商业搜索引擎上进行了大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估，验证了框架的实际价值。
experiment_results: 离线评估显示，AuthGR在权威性和准确性上均优于基线，且3B模型性能与14B基线相当。
大规模在线A/B测试和人工评估证实，AuthGR显著提升了真实用户参与度和可靠性。
具体数值未在摘要中提供，但明确提及了显著改进。
limitations: 摘要未提供具体离线指标数值，难以量化改进幅度。
多模态权威评分依赖视觉语言模型，可能增加计算开销和部署复杂度。
框架在非商业场景（如学术搜索）的泛化性未在摘要中讨论。
papers.practical_value: AuthGR可直接应用于商业搜索引擎，提升高风险领域（如医疗、金融）的检索结果可信度，减少用户接触不可靠信息的风险。其在线A/B测试的成功表明，该框架具备实际部署价值，可改善用户体验和平台可靠性。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文填补了生成式检索中权威性研究的空白，提出了一种可落地的解决方案，并通过商业级验证证明了其有效性。对于关注检索质量、可信信息获取和LLM实际应用的研究者与工程师，本文提供了重要的技术路线和实证依据。

papers.title: Beyond the Flat Sequence: Hierarchical and Preference-Aware Generative Recommendations
papers.abstract: Generative Recommenders (GRs), exemplified by the Hierarchical Sequential Transduction Unit (HSTU), have emerged as a powerful paradigm for modeling long user interaction sequences. However, we observe that their "flat-sequence" assumption overlooks the rich, intrinsic structure of user behavior. This leads to two key limitations: a failure to capture the temporal hierarchy of session-based engagement, and computational inefficiency, as dense attention introduces significant noise that obscures true preference signals within semantically sparse histories, which deteriorates the quality of the learned representations. To this end, we propose a novel framework named HPGR (Hierarchical and Preference-aware Generative Recommender), built upon a two-stage paradigm that injects these crucial structural priors into the model to handle the drawback. Specifically, HPGR comprises two synergistic stages. First, a structure-aware pre-training stage employs a session-based Masked Item Modeling (MIM) objective to learn a hierarchically-informed and semantically rich item representation space. Second, a preference-aware fine-tuning stage leverages these powerful representations to implement a Preference-Guided Sparse Attention mechanism, which dynamically constrains computation to only the most relevant historical items, enhancing both efficiency and signal-to-noise ratio. Empirical experiments on a large-scale proprietary industrial dataset from APPGallery and an online A/B test verify that HPGR achieves state-of-the-art performance over multiple strong baselines, including HSTU and MTGR.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐系统（如HSTU）在长序列建模中表现优异，但其“扁平序列”假设忽略了用户行为的层次结构，导致无法捕捉会话级时间层次，且密集注意力在语义稀疏的历史中引入噪声，降低表示质量。为此，本文提出HPGR框架，采用两阶段范式注入结构先验：结构感知预训练阶段使用基于会话的掩码物品建模（MIM）学习层次化且语义丰富的物品表示；偏好感知微调阶段利用这些表示实现偏好引导的稀疏注意力，动态限制计算到最相关的历史物品，提升效率和信噪比。在APPGallery大规模专有工业数据集和在线A/B测试中，HPGR优于HSTU和MTGR等强基线。
papers.one_line_takeaway: HPGR通过层次化预训练和偏好引导稀疏注意力，解决了生成式推荐中扁平序列假设带来的结构缺失和计算噪声问题。
papers.core_method: 两阶段范式：1）结构感知预训练，采用会话级掩码物品建模（MIM）学习层次化物品表示；2）偏好感知微调，使用偏好引导的稀疏注意力机制，动态选择最相关的历史物品进行计算。
innovation_points: 首次将层次化结构先验（会话级时间层次）注入生成式推荐模型，弥补扁平序列假设的不足。
提出偏好引导的稀疏注意力，根据用户偏好动态约束计算范围，降低噪声并提升效率。
两阶段训练范式（预训练+微调）协同工作，预训练学习表示，微调利用表示进行高效推理。
experiment_results: 在APPGallery大规模专有工业数据集上，HPGR优于HSTU和MTGR等多个强基线，达到SOTA性能。
在线A/B测试验证了HPGR的实际效果，但具体指标数值未在摘要中给出。
limitations: 依赖专有工业数据集，未在公开数据集上验证，泛化性未知。
层次化结构先验的构建需要会话划分，可能不适用于无明确会话边界的场景。
偏好引导稀疏注意力的计算开销和超参数敏感性未详细讨论。
papers.practical_value: HPGR在真实工业推荐系统（APPGallery）中验证了有效性，通过层次化建模和稀疏注意力，在保持推荐质量的同时提升计算效率，适合处理长用户序列的线上部署。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐的核心假设缺陷提出改进，将结构先验与稀疏注意力结合，为提升长序列建模的效率和效果提供了新思路，对工业推荐系统有直接参考价值。

papers.title: OneSearch-V2: The Latent Reasoning Enhanced Self-distillation Generative Search Framework
papers.abstract: Generative Retrieval (GR) has emerged as a promising paradigm for modern search systems. Compared to multi-stage cascaded architecture, it offers advantages such as end-to-end joint optimization and high computational efficiency. OneSearch, as a representative industrial-scale deployed generative search framework, has brought significant commercial and operational benefits. However, its inadequate understanding of complex queries, inefficient exploitation of latent user intents, and overfitting to narrow historical preferences have limited its further performance improvement. To address these challenges, we propose OneSearch-V2, a latent reasoning enhanced self-distillation generative search framework. It contains three key innovations: (1) a thought-augmented complex query understanding module, which enables deep query understanding and overcomes the shallow semantic matching limitations of direct inference; (2) a reasoning-internalized self-distillation training pipeline, which uncovers users' potential yet precise e-commerce intentions beyond log-fitting through implicit in-context learning; (3) a behavior preference alignment optimization system, which mitigates reward hacking arising from the single conversion metric, and addresses personal preference via direct user feedback. Extensive offline evaluations demonstrate OneSearch-V2's strong query recognition and user profiling capabilities. Online A/B tests further validate its business effectiveness, yielding +3.98\% item CTR, +2.07\% buyer volume, and +2.11\% order volume. Manual evaluation further confirms gains in search experience quality, with +1.37\% in page good rate and +1.65\% in query-item relevance. More importantly, OneSearch-V2 effectively mitigates common search system issues such as information bubbles and long-tail sparsity, without incurring additional inference costs or serving latency.
papers.summary: OneSearch-V2 是一个面向工业级生成式搜索的潜在推理增强自蒸馏框架，旨在解决现有生成式检索（GR）系统在复杂查询理解、潜在用户意图利用和历史偏好过拟合方面的不足。该框架包含三个关键创新：思维增强的复杂查询理解模块，通过生成思维链实现深度查询理解；推理内化的自蒸馏训练流程，利用隐式上下文学习挖掘用户潜在意图；行为偏好对齐优化系统，缓解单一转化指标导致的奖励黑客问题。离线评估显示其查询识别和用户画像能力增强，在线A/B测试带来商品点击率提升3.98%、买家数提升2.07%、订单量提升2.11%，人工评估显示页面好评率提升1.37%、查询-商品相关性提升1.65%，且无额外推理成本或延迟。
papers.one_line_takeaway: OneSearch-V2通过潜在推理增强和自蒸馏训练，在不增加推理成本的前提下显著提升生成式搜索的复杂查询理解和用户意图挖掘能力。

设计推理内化的自蒸馏训练流程，通过隐式上下文学习挖掘用户潜在意图

人工评估：页面好评率提升1.37%，查询-商品相关性提升1.65%

papers.title: Awakening Dormant Users: Generative Recommendation with Counterfactual Functional Role Reasoning
papers.abstract: Awakening dormant users, who remain engaged but exhibit low conversion, is a pivotal driver for incremental GMV growth in large-scale e-commerce platforms. However, existing approaches often yield suboptimal results since they typically rely on single-step estimation of an item's intrinsic value (e.g., immediate click probability). This mechanism overlooks the instrumental effect of items, where specific interactions act as triggers to shape latent intent and drive subsequent decisions along a conversion trajectory. To bridge this gap, we propose RoleGen, a novel framework that synergizes a Conversion Trajectory Reasoner with a Generative Behavioral Backbone. Specifically, the LLM-based Reasoner explicitly models the context-dependent Functional Role of items to reconstruct intent evolution. It further employs counterfactual inference to simulate diverse conversion paths, effectively mitigating interest collapse. These reasoned candidate items are integrated into the generative backbone, which is optimized via a collaborative "Reasoning-Execution-Feedback-Reflection" closed-loop strategy to ensure grounded execution. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing on the Kuaishou e-commerce platform demonstrate that RoleGen achieves a 6.2% gain in Recall@1 and a 7.3% increase in online order volume, confirming its effectiveness in activating the dormant user base.
papers.summary: 针对电商平台中沉睡用户（保持活跃但转化率低）难以激活的问题，现有方法通常仅基于物品内在价值（如点击率）进行单步估计，忽视了物品在转化轨迹中的工具性作用。为此，本文提出RoleGen框架，结合基于LLM的转化轨迹推理器与生成式行为主干。推理器显式建模物品的上下文相关功能角色，以重构用户意图演化，并通过反事实推断模拟多样转化路径，缓解兴趣坍缩。推理出的候选物品被整合进生成式主干，通过“推理-执行-反馈-反思”闭环策略优化，确保落地执行。在快手电商平台上的离线实验和在线A/B测试表明，RoleGen在Recall@1上提升6.2%，在线订单量提升7.3%，有效激活沉睡用户。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过反事实功能角色推理增强生成式推荐，可有效激活沉睡用户并显著提升在线订单量。
papers.core_method: 提出RoleGen框架，包含两个核心组件：1）基于LLM的转化轨迹推理器，显式建模物品的功能角色并重构用户意图演化，通过反事实推断生成多样化的候选物品；2）生成式行为主干，采用“推理-执行-反馈-反思”闭环策略优化，将推理结果整合到生成过程中，确保推荐的可执行性。
innovation_points: 首次将功能角色推理引入生成式推荐，显式建模物品在转化轨迹中的工具性作用。
利用反事实推断模拟多样转化路径，缓解兴趣坍缩问题。
设计“推理-执行-反馈-反思”闭环策略，将LLM推理与生成式推荐优化紧密结合。

在线A/B测试：在线订单量提升7.3%。
limitations: 依赖LLM推理，可能带来较高的计算成本。

实验仅在快手电商平台验证，泛化性有待进一步检验。
papers.practical_value: 该框架可直接应用于电商平台的沉睡用户激活场景，通过生成式推荐提升转化率和GMV，具有明确的商业价值。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐中的关键问题——物品的工具性价值，提出了创新解决方案，并通过大规模在线实验验证了有效性，对推荐系统研究和工业应用均有重要参考价值。

papers.title: RCLRec: Reverse Curriculum Learning for Modeling Sparse Conversions in Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Conversion objectives in large-scale recommender systems are sparse, making them difficult to optimize. Generative recommendation (GR) partially alleviates data sparsity by organizing multi-type behaviors into a unified token sequence with shared representations, but conversion signals remain insufficiently modeled. While recent behavior-aware GR models encode behavior types and employ behavior-aware attention to highlight decision-related intermediate behaviors, they still rely on standard attention over the full history and provide no additional supervision for conversions, leaving conversion sparsity largely unresolved. To address these challenges, we propose RCLRec, a reverse curriculum learning-based GR framework for sparse conversion supervision. For each conversion target, RCLRec constructs a short curriculum by selecting a subsequence of conversion-related items from the history in reverse. Their semantic tokens are fed to the decoder as a prefix, together with the target conversion tokens, under a joint generation objective. This design provides additional instance-specific intermediate supervision, alleviating conversion sparsity and focusing the model on the user's critical decision process. We further introduce a curriculum quality-aware loss to ensure that the selected curricula are informative for conversion prediction. Experiments on offline datasets and an online A/B test show that RCLRec achieves superior performance, with +2.09% advertising revenue and +1.86% orders in online deployment.
papers.summary: 大规模推荐系统中的转化目标稀疏，难以优化。生成式推荐（GR）通过将多类型行为统一为token序列并共享表示，部分缓解了数据稀疏问题，但转化信号仍建模不足。现有行为感知GR模型虽编码行为类型并采用行为感知注意力突出决策相关中间行为，但仍依赖全历史的标准注意力，且未对转化提供额外监督，转化稀疏问题未根本解决。为此，本文提出RCLRec，一种基于反向课程学习的GR框架，用于稀疏转化监督。对每个转化目标，RCLRec从历史中选取转化相关物品的子序列，按反向顺序构建短课程，将其语义token作为前缀与目标转化token一起输入解码器，采用联合生成目标。该设计提供额外的实例级中间监督，缓解转化稀疏，并聚焦用户关键决策过程。进一步引入课程质量感知损失，确保所选课程对转化预测有信息量。离线数据集和在线A/B测试表明，RCLRec性能优越，在线部署中广告收入+2.09%，订单+1.86%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RCLRec通过反向课程学习为生成式推荐提供转化相关的中间监督，有效缓解转化稀疏问题，并在在线业务中显著提升广告收入和订单量。
papers.core_method: RCLRec框架：对每个转化目标，从用户历史中选取转化相关物品子序列，按反向顺序构建短课程，将其语义token作为解码器前缀，与目标转化token联合生成，并引入课程质量感知损失优化课程选择。
innovation_points: 提出反向课程学习策略，为转化目标构建短课程，提供实例级中间监督，缓解转化稀疏。
将课程token作为解码器前缀，与目标转化token联合生成，增强模型对用户决策过程的建模。

papers.title: Not Only NTP: Extending Training Signal Coverage for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Next-Token Prediction (NTP) carries two structural training signal limitations. First, NTP optimizes for single-step prediction only, placing no supervised pressure on learning longer-range behavioral structure -- we term this \textbf{temporal locality}. Second, in multi-domain sequences, each target item embedding receives gradient updates exclusively from the immediately preceding hidden state, with no explicit gradient pathway from cross-domain context -- we term this \textbf{spatial locality}. We propose \textbf{NONTP}, extending NTP's signal coverage along both dimensions through two auxiliary objectives. \textbf{TCL (Temporal Contrastive Learning)} uses a BYOL-style EMA teacher with InfoNCE to align hidden states against a $K$-step future trajectory in representation space. \textbf{TDL (Trans-Domain Learning)} mean-pools cross-domain hidden states and predicts through the shared prediction head, opening a second gradient pathway with no additional parameters. Both are discarded at inference: zero overhead. On a four-domain Meituan industrial dataset (full ranking), NONTP achieves HR@10 +34.3\% over NTP and +18.3\% over MBGR. On the public Amazon Movie-Book-CDs benchmark, HR@10 +2.8\% and NDCG@10 +3.7\%. Online A/B tests confirm CTR +1.8\% and GMV +2.1\% (both $p < 0.01$). Ablation studies confirm each component contributes independently, with gradient conflict analyzed as a direction for future work.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式推荐中Next-Token Prediction（NTP）训练信号的结构性局限，提出NONTP框架。NTP存在时间局部性（仅优化单步预测，缺乏长程行为结构监督）和空间局部性（多域序列中目标嵌入仅从紧邻隐状态获得梯度，缺乏跨域上下文梯度路径）。为扩展信号覆盖，作者提出两个辅助目标：TCL（时间对比学习）采用BYOL风格EMA教师和InfoNCE损失，将隐状态与K步未来轨迹在表示空间对齐；TDL（跨域学习）对跨域隐状态进行均值池化并通过共享预测头预测，开辟无额外参数的第二梯度路径。推理时丢弃辅助模块，零开销。在美团四域工业数据集（全排序）上，HR@10较NTP提升34.3%，较MBGR提升18.3%；在公开Amazon Movie-Book-CDs基准上，HR@10提升2.8%，NDCG@10提升3.7%。在线A/B测试确认CTR提升1.8%，GMV提升2.1%（均p<0.01）。消融实验验证各组件独立贡献，并分析梯度冲突作为未来方向。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过时间对比学习和跨域学习扩展NTP训练信号覆盖，显著提升生成式推荐性能且推理零开销。

limitations: 未提供消融实验中梯度冲突的具体量化分析，仅作为未来方向提及。
实验主要基于推荐场景，未验证在其他生成式任务（如文本生成）中的泛化性。
TCL的K步未来轨迹选择可能依赖超参数，未讨论敏感性。
papers.practical_value: NONTP在工业推荐系统中可直接应用，推理零开销，在线A/B测试显示CTR和GMV显著提升，表明其能有效改善用户参与度和商业价值，适合部署于多域推荐场景。

papers.title: Reward Guided Decoding for Generative Recommendation
papers.abstract: Generative recommendation formulates recommendation task into an SID sequence autoregressive generation paradigm, but the decoding process is often dominated by generation likelihood. This may conflict with real-world business objectives, where high-value candidates can receive low generation probability and be pruned early during beam search. Existing reranking or training-time alignment methods either intervene too late or require costly model retraining when business preferences change. To this end, we propose \textbf{R}eward \textbf{G}uided \textbf{D}ecoding, named \textbf{RGD}, a controllable decoding framework for industrial value-oriented generative recommendation. We formulate value-guided decoding as a KL-regularized reward maximization problem, deriving a closed-form reward guided decoding distribution that principledly combines generation probability with reward signals. RGD treats the base generator as a reference policy and introduces a reward model as a test-time controller, injecting reward into each decoding step to reshape the search trajectory without retraining the generator. Extensive offline and online experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach for aligning personalization and business value. RGD has been deployed on the Kuaishou platform, bringing consistent improvements in real-world recommendation scenarios.
papers.summary: 生成式推荐将推荐任务建模为语义ID序列的自回归生成，但解码过程常被生成似然主导，与真实业务目标冲突，高价值候选可能因低生成概率在束搜索早期被剪枝。现有重排序或训练时对齐方法干预过晚或需昂贵重训练。本文提出奖励引导解码（RGD），一种面向工业价值导向生成式推荐的可控解码框架。将价值引导解码形式化为KL正则化奖励最大化问题，推导出闭式奖励引导解码分布，原则性地结合生成概率与奖励信号。RGD将基础生成器视为参考策略，引入奖励模型作为测试时控制器，在每步解码注入奖励以重塑搜索轨迹，无需重训练生成器。离线与在线实验证明其在个性化与业务价值对齐上的有效性，已在快手平台部署，带来真实推荐场景的持续改进。
papers.one_line_takeaway: RGD通过测试时奖励引导解码，在不重训练生成器的情况下，将业务价值注入生成式推荐的每一步搜索，实现个性化与商业目标的对齐。
papers.core_method: 将价值引导解码形式化为KL正则化奖励最大化问题，推导闭式解，得到奖励引导解码分布，在解码每一步结合生成概率与奖励信号，以基础生成器为参考策略，奖励模型为测试时控制器，调整束搜索轨迹。
innovation_points: 提出测试时奖励引导解码框架，无需重训练生成器即可调整解码策略，适应业务偏好变化。
从KL正则化奖励最大化推导闭式解码分布，原则性结合生成概率与奖励信号。
在工业级生成式推荐中验证，并成功部署于快手平台，展示实际业务价值。
experiment_results: 离线实验证明RGD在个性化与业务价值对齐上优于基线。
在线实验显示RGD在快手真实推荐场景中带来持续改进。
具体数值未在摘要中提供。
limitations: 摘要未提供具体性能数值，效果量化不明确。
依赖奖励模型质量，奖励模型偏差可能影响解码。

papers.practical_value: RGD为工业推荐系统提供了一种灵活的价值对齐方案，业务偏好变化时无需重训练模型，可快速调整解码策略，已在快手部署并提升真实场景效果，适合高价值候选挖掘和商业目标优化。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文针对生成式推荐中生成似然与业务目标冲突的核心问题，提出测试时可控解码新范式，兼具理论推导和工业验证，为生成式推荐在真实业务中的落地提供了关键思路，值得关注。

papers.title: Stochastic Primal-Dual Decoding for Multiobjective Generative Recommender Systems
papers.abstract: Recent advances in recommender systems (RS) have shown substantial performance gains through generative modelling. In practice, recommendation often involves constructing slates -- ordered lists of items -- that must satisfy multiple objectives beyond relevance, such as constraints defined over item attributes or fairness constraints. Existing multiobjective approaches either rely on post-processing techniques designed for non-generative settings, or incorporate auxiliary objectives directly into model training. The former does not explicitly account for the sequential nature of generative RS, while the latter is often impractical in large-scale systems. We propose a lightweight, inference-time decoding layer that augments autoregressive generative RS to support multiobjective slate generation without modifying or retraining the underlying model. We formulate decoding as an online constrained optimisation problem, where items are selected sequentially, and trade-offs between relevance and auxiliary objectives are adjusted dynamically based on the remaining constraint slack, i.e., how much of each objective remains to be satisfied. This is implemented via a stochastic primal-dual approximation scheme that balances relevance and auxiliary objectives during generation. We provide theoretical guarantees on constraint violation and regret, and evaluate the proposed approach through extensive offline experiments and a large-scale online A/B experiment in a real-world recommender system. Our results show consistent improvements in multiobjective trade-offs, including a +1.8\% gain in the auxiliary objectives achieved at zero cost to user satisfaction.
papers.summary: 本文针对生成式推荐系统（RS）在多目标槽位构建中的挑战，提出了一种轻量级的推理时解码层。现有方法要么依赖非生成式设置的后处理技术，要么将辅助目标直接纳入训练，但前者未考虑生成式RS的序列特性，后者在大规模系统中不实用。本文将解码过程建模为在线约束优化问题，通过随机原始-对偶近似方案，在生成过程中动态调整相关性与辅助目标（如公平性、属性约束）之间的权衡，基于剩余约束松弛度进行决策。理论分析提供了约束违反和遗憾的保证。离线实验和真实推荐系统的大规模在线A/B实验表明，该方法在多目标权衡上持续改进，在用户满意度零损失的情况下，辅助目标提升+1.8%。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 提出一种无需重新训练模型的推理时随机原始-对偶解码方法，可动态平衡生成式推荐中的多目标约束，实现零成本辅助目标提升。
papers.core_method: 随机原始-对偶近似解码层：将槽位生成视为在线约束优化，每步选择物品时根据当前约束松弛度调整相关性与辅助目标的权重，通过原始-对偶更新保证约束满足和低遗憾。
innovation_points: 提出推理时解码层，无需修改或重训练底层生成模型，即可支持多目标槽位生成。
将解码形式化为在线约束优化，并采用随机原始-对偶算法动态调整目标权衡。
提供理论保证（约束违反和遗憾界），并验证于真实大规模推荐系统。
experiment_results: 离线实验显示多目标权衡一致改进。
在线A/B实验：辅助目标提升+1.8%，用户满意度零损失。
limitations: 依赖底层生成模型的序列输出，可能不适用于非自回归生成器。
理论保证基于特定假设，实际约束可能更复杂。
未详细讨论计算开销，但声称轻量级。
papers.practical_value: 为生成式推荐系统提供了一种即插即用的多目标控制方案，企业无需重新训练模型即可满足公平性、多样性等业务约束，降低部署成本，并能在线上实现可量化的业务指标提升。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作填补了生成式推荐中多目标解码的空白，将在线优化与生成模型结合，兼顾理论严谨性和工程实用性，为大规模推荐系统提供了新思路。

papers.title: Towards Sustainable Growth: A Multi-Value-Aware Retrieval Framework for E-Commerce Search
papers.abstract: New item growth is critical for maintaining a healthy ecosystem in large-scale e-commerce platforms. However, existing systems tend to prioritize presenting users with already popular items, a phenomenon often referred to as the "Matthew effect". In the context of search retrieval, current cold-start models suffer from the misalignment between training objectives and online business metrics, and they lack effective mechanisms to measure an item's growth potential. In this paper, we propose a Multi-Value-Aware retrieval framework tailored for e-commerce search, designed to better align with the cascaded online values across different stages of the search system while balancing immediate conversion and long-term item growth. Our framework GrowthGR consists of two key components: an Item Long-term Transaction Value Prediction (ItemLTV) module and a Multi-Value-Aware Generative Retrieval (MultiGR) module. First, in the ItemLTV module, we employ counterfactual inference to quantify the long-term value increment attributable to a single user interaction. Second, in the MultiGR module, building upon a semantic-ID-based generative retrieval architecture, we leverage structured samples with the search cascade signals and adopt a Multi-Value-Aware Policy Optimization (MoPO) training paradigm to align with multi-stage online values, while explicitly balancing short-term transactional value and long-term growth potential estimated by ItemLTV. We successfully deployed GrowthGR on Taobao's production platform, achieving a substantial 5.3% lift in new item GMV while delivering a non-trivial 0.3% gain in overall search GMV. Extensive online analysis and A/B testing demonstrate its positive impact on the overall ecosystem value.
papers.summary: 本文提出GrowthGR框架，用于电商搜索中的新品增长。现有系统受马太效应影响，冷启动模型训练目标与线上业务指标不一致，且缺乏衡量商品增长潜力的机制。GrowthGR包含两个模块：ItemLTV模块利用反事实推断量化单次用户交互带来的长期交易价值增量；MultiGR模块基于语义ID的生成式检索架构，使用搜索级联信号的结构化样本，并采用多价值感知策略优化（MoPO）训练范式，对齐多阶段线上价值，平衡短期交易价值和长期增长潜力。在淘宝生产平台部署后，新品GMV提升5.3%，整体搜索GMV提升0.3%。

papers.title: Climber-Pilot: A Non-Myopic Generative Recommendation Model Towards Better Instruction-Following
papers.abstract: Generative retrieval has emerged as a promising paradigm in recommender systems, offering superior sequence modeling capabilities over traditional dual-tower architectures. However, in large-scale industrial scenarios, such models often suffer from inherent myopia: due to single-step inference and strict latency constraints, they tend to collapse diverse user intents into locally optimal predictions, failing to capture long-horizon and multi-item consumption patterns. Moreover, real-world retrieval systems must follow explicit retrieval instructions, such as category-level control and policy constraints. Incorporating such instruction-following behavior into generative retrieval remains challenging, as existing conditioning or post-hoc filtering approaches often compromise relevance or efficiency. In this work, we present Climber-Pilot, a unified generative retrieval framework to address both limitations. First, we introduce Time-Aware Multi-Item Prediction (TAMIP), a novel training paradigm designed to mitigate inherent myopia in generative retrieval. By distilling long-horizon, multi-item foresight into model parameters through time-aware masking, TAMIP alleviates locally optimal predictions while preserving efficient single-step inference. Second, to support flexible instruction-following retrieval, we propose Condition-Guided Sparse Attention (CGSA), which incorporates business constraints directly into the generative process via sparse attention, without introducing additional inference steps. Extensive offline experiments and online A/B testing at NetEase Cloud Music, one of the largest music streaming platforms, demonstrate that Climber-Pilot significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving a 4.24\% lift of the core business metric.
papers.summary: 生成式检索在推荐系统中展现出优于双塔架构的序列建模能力，但在大规模工业场景中面临固有短视问题：单步推理和严格延迟约束导致模型将多样用户意图坍缩为局部最优预测，难以捕捉长期多物品消费模式。此外，真实检索系统需遵循显式指令（如类目控制、策略约束），现有条件化或后处理过滤方法难以兼顾相关性与效率。本文提出Climber-Pilot统一生成式检索框架，包含两个核心组件：时间感知多物品预测（TAMIP）通过时间感知掩码将长期多物品前瞻蒸馏进模型参数，缓解局部最优同时保持单步推理效率；条件引导稀疏注意力（CGSA）通过稀疏注意力将业务约束直接融入生成过程，不增加推理步骤。在网易云音乐的大规模离线实验和在线A/B测试中，Climber-Pilot显著优于最先进基线，核心业务指标提升4.24%。

papers.title: CADET: Context-Conditioned Ads CTR Prediction With a Decoder-Only Transformer
papers.abstract: Click-through rate (CTR) prediction is fundamental to online advertising systems. While Deep Learning Recommendation Models (DLRMs) with explicit feature interactions have long dominated this domain, recent advances in generative recommenders have shown promising results in content recommendation. However, adapting these transformer-based architectures to ads CTR prediction still presents unique challenges, including handling post-scoring contextual signals, maintaining offline-online consistency, and scaling to industrial workloads. We present CADET (Context-Conditioned Ads Decoder-Only Transformer), an end-to-end decoder-only transformer for ads CTR prediction deployed at LinkedIn. Our approach introduces several key innovations: (1) a context-conditioned decoding architecture with multi-tower prediction heads that explicitly model post-scoring signals such as ad position, resolving the chicken-and-egg problem between predicted CTR and ranking; (2) a self-gated attention mechanism that stabilizes training by adaptively regulating information flow at both representation and interaction levels; (3) a timestamp-based variant of Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) that captures temporal relationships across timescales from seconds to months; (4) session masking strategies that prevent the model from learning dependencies on unavailable in-session events, addressing train-serve skew; and (5) production engineering techniques including tensor packing, sequence chunking, and custom Flash Attention kernels that enable efficient training and serving at scale. In online A/B testing, CADET achieves a 11.04\% CTR lift compared to the production LiRank baseline model, a hybrid ensemble of DCNv2 and sequential encoders. The system has been successfully deployed on LinkedIn's advertising platform, serving the main traffic for homefeed sponsored updates.
papers.summary: CADET是LinkedIn提出的用于广告点击率（CTR）预测的端到端解码器专用Transformer模型。针对广告CTR预测中后打分上下文信号（如广告位置）与CTR排序的鸡生蛋问题、离线在线一致性以及工业规模扩展等挑战，CADET引入了上下文条件解码架构和多塔预测头，显式建模后打分信号；自门控注意力机制在表示和交互层面自适应调节信息流以稳定训练；基于时间戳的旋转位置编码（RoPE）捕捉从秒到月的时间关系；会话掩码策略防止模型依赖不可用的会话内事件，减少训练服务偏差；并采用张量打包、序列分块和自定义Flash Attention内核等工程优化。在线A/B测试中，CADET相比生产基线LiRank（DCNv2与序列编码器的混合集成）实现了11.04%的CTR提升，已部署于LinkedIn广告平台，服务主页信息流赞助内容的主要流量。

papers.title: Zing: Social Mind for LLMs
papers.abstract: As large language models move from isolated task solving toward long-term service in human environments, they require social intelligence: the ability to infer mental states, track social relations, reason over norms, and adapt behavior under context. This report presents Zhijing, an integrated framework for measuring, internalizing, and grounding social intelligence. For measurement, we introduce SoMBench, a psychology-grounded benchmark spanning 3 primary dimensions, 17 secondary dimensions, and 71 task paradigms. It controls question format, narrative perspective, and context length across 284 shared scenarios and 3,481 expert-verified instances. Evaluation of 20 representative LLMs reveals substantial headroom: the best model achieves only 72.08% overall accuracy, and none of the 17 secondary dimensions reaches the 90% near-ceiling band. For internalization, we develop Zing, a diagnosis-driven training recipe combining supervised fine-tuning, on-policy distillation, and rubric-based reinforcement learning. Across five social-cognition benchmarks, Zing consistently outperforms its base models, with Zing-27B-Stage2 achieving the best average score and Zing-32B-Stage2 remaining competitive with DeepSeek-V4-Pro. For deployment-time grounding, we build Actio, a harness-controlled inference architecture that routes four typed supports into reasoning: PRISM for procedural guidance, Starling for runtime mental-state representation, SAGE for reusable experience, and gated RAG for external social and normative knowledge. Across five base models and three benchmarks, the full harness improves 14 of 15 model-benchmark pairs and is best or tied for best in 8, demonstrating the effectiveness of typed runtime support. Together, these results show that socially intelligent LLMs require coordinated advances in evaluation, parametric internalization, and deployment-time grounding.
papers.summary: 本文提出Zing框架，系统性地解决大语言模型（LLM）的社会智能问题。社会智能指模型推断心理状态、追踪社会关系、推理规范并适应上下文的能力。作者首先构建SoMBench基准，基于心理学理论，覆盖3个主维度、17个子维度和71个任务范式，包含284个共享场景和3481个专家验证实例，并控制问题格式、叙事视角和上下文长度。对20个代表性LLM的评估显示，最佳模型准确率仅72.08%，且所有子维度均未达到90%的接近天花板水平，表明巨大提升空间。其次，提出Zing训练方法，结合监督微调、在线策略蒸馏和基于规则（rubric）的强化学习，在五个社会认知基准上持续优于基础模型，其中Zing-27B-Stage2平均分最佳，Zing-32B-Stage2与DeepSeek-V4-Pro竞争。最后，构建Actio推理架构，在部署时通过四种类型化支持（PRISM程序指导、Starling运行时心理状态表示、SAGE可复用经验、门控RAG外部知识）增强推理。在五个基础模型和三个基准上，完整架构在15个模型-基准对中改善14个，并在8个中达到最佳或并列最佳。结果表明，社会智能LLM需要评估、参数内化和部署时落地的协同进步。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 社会智能LLM需要评估、参数内化和部署时落地的协同进步，Zing框架通过SoMBench基准、诊断驱动训练和Actio推理架构显著提升模型社会智能。
papers.core_method: Zing框架包含三部分：1）SoMBench基准，基于心理学理论设计，控制变量并专家验证；2）Zing训练方法，结合监督微调、在线策略蒸馏和基于规则的强化学习；3）Actio推理架构，在推理时路由四种类型化支持（PRISM、Starling、SAGE、门控RAG）到推理过程。
innovation_points: 提出SoMBench基准，覆盖多维度社会认知任务，并严格控制问题格式、视角和上下文长度，确保评估可靠性。
提出诊断驱动的训练方法Zing，结合SFT、在线策略蒸馏和基于规则的RL，有效内化社会智能。
提出Actio推理架构，通过类型化运行时支持（程序指导、心理状态表示、经验复用、外部知识）增强部署时社会推理。
系统性地将评估、训练和推理三个层面结合，展示协同进步的必要性。
experiment_results: SoMBench评估：20个LLM中最佳模型准确率仅72.08%，17个子维度均未达到90%准确率，表明显著提升空间。
Zing训练：在五个社会认知基准上，Zing-27B-Stage2平均分最佳，Zing-32B-Stage2与DeepSeek-V4-Pro竞争。
Actio推理：在五个基础模型和三个基准上，完整架构改善14/15模型-基准对，并在8个中达到最佳或并列最佳。
limitations: SoMBench基准虽覆盖广泛，但可能未涵盖所有社会智能维度，且实例数量有限（3481个）。
Zing训练方法依赖特定基础模型，泛化性需进一步验证。
Actio推理架构增加推理复杂度，可能影响部署效率，且未报告具体延迟或成本数据。
papers.practical_value: Zing框架为构建社会智能LLM提供了可操作的评估基准、训练方法和推理架构。企业可应用SoMBench评估模型社会能力，采用Zing训练提升模型表现，并利用Actio在部署时增强社会推理，适用于社交机器人、辅助对话、人机协作等场景，提升用户体验和任务成功率。
papers.why_it_matters: 本文首次系统性地将社会智能的评估、训练和推理结合，提出完整框架，并展示显著效果。对于LLM研究社区，它明确了社会智能的挑战和解决路径；对于企业，它提供了可落地的技术方案。值得读因为它不仅提出新基准和方法，还通过实验证明协同进步的重要性，推动LLM从孤立任务解决走向长期社会服务。

papers.title: Retrofitting Linear Attention into Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion language models (dLLMs) offer a promising alternative to autoregressive models by accelerating inference through parallel decoding. Recent dLLMs commonly use blockwise semi-autoregressive decoding, generating blocks autoregressively while denoising tokens within each active block in parallel. However, despite KV caching, each denoising step still attends to all previous blocks, repeatedly incurring prefix-attention cost. Motivated by this bottleneck, we ask whether dLLM inference can be further accelerated by linearizing attention over previous blocks. We introduce block-hybrid attention, which retains exact softmax attention within the active denoising block while applying linear attention over previous blocks. We show that this hybrid attention can be retrofitted into a pretrained dLLM with minimal post-training: LLaDA-Hybrid replaces 6 of the 20 attention layers in LLaDA~2.1, a 16B open-source dLLM, largely following LoLCAT (Zhang et al, 2024). The conversion takes only approximately 60 hours while preserving benchmark performance: 72.0% vs. 75.6% on HumanEval, 63.0% vs. 57.7% on MBPP+, and 86.7% vs. 88.3% on CMATH. With a Triton implementation, LLaDA-Hybrid achieves up to $1.7\times$ higher decoding throughput and supports more concurrent requests before exhausting memory, showing that pretrained dLLMs can be efficiently linearized for faster inference. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Diuven/LLaDA-Hybrid.
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: 扩散语言模型（dLLMs）通过并行解码加速推理，但现有块状半自回归解码在每一步去噪时仍需关注所有先前块，导致前缀注意力成本重复计算。本文提出块混合注意力（block-hybrid attention），在活动去噪块内保留精确softmax注意力，对先前块使用线性注意力，从而降低推理成本。作者将LLaDA 2.1（16B开源dLLM）中20个注意力层中的6层替换为线性注意力，仅需约60小时的后训练即可完成改造。在HumanEval、MBPP+和CMATH基准上，性能分别达到72.0%（原75.6%）、63.0%（原57.7%）和86.7%（原88.3%），略有波动但总体保持。Triton实现使解码吞吐量提升至1.7倍，并支持更多并发请求。该工作证明预训练dLLM可被高效线性化以加速推理。
papers.one_line_takeaway: 通过将部分注意力层替换为线性注意力，预训练扩散语言模型可在保持性能的同时显著提升解码吞吐量。
papers.core_method: 块混合注意力：在活动去噪块内使用精确softmax注意力，对先前块使用线性注意力；基于LoLCAT方法对LLaDA 2.1进行后训练改造，替换6/20层注意力层。
innovation_points: 提出块混合注意力机制，结合精确与线性注意力，针对dLLM的块状解码瓶颈。
证明预训练dLLM可通过最小后训练（约60小时）实现线性化，无需从头训练。
提供Triton实现，实际提升解码吞吐量1.7倍，并支持更多并发请求。
experiment_results: HumanEval: 72.0% vs 75.6%（原模型），性能略有下降但可接受。
MBPP+: 63.0% vs 57.7%，性能提升。
CMATH: 86.7% vs 88.3%，略有下降。解码吞吐量提升至1.7倍。
limitations: 性能在部分基准上略有下降（如HumanEval和CMATH）。

后训练时间约60小时，虽短但仍有成本。
papers.practical_value: 该技术可直接应用于现有dLLM推理系统，通过提高吞吐量和并发能力，降低部署成本，适用于需要大规模并行解码的场景。
papers.why_it_matters: 该工作首次展示预训练dLLM可被高效线性化，为扩散语言模型的推理加速提供了新方向，同时保持性能，具有实际部署价值。

papers.title: SLAI T-Rex: Full-Parameter Post-training of the DeepSeek-V4 Family on Ascend SuperPOD
papers.abstract: Full-parameter post-training of trillion-parameter-scale MoE models introduces substantial system-level challenges for large-scale distributed training, including severe memory pressure, non-overlapped communication overhead, and inefficient kernel execution. While most large-scale LLM training systems are built around GPU-based clusters, this report presents an end-to-end optimization practice on the Ascend NPU SuperPOD. Using the DeepSeek-V4 model family as the target workload, we develop a hierarchical optimization framework spanning model-level parallelism, computation-communication orchestration, and low-level kernel execution. The resulting system achieves 34.22% Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) with a 2.93x improvement over the open-source baseline recipe while maintaining training stability. Building on this optimized infrastructure, we further establish a CPT and SFT workflow for complex Operations Research (OR) tasks. We refer to the integrated framework as SLAI T-Rex. Using DeepSeek-V4-Flash, we develop OR-oriented CPT and SFT data pipelines that combine collected domain resources with solver-verified synthetic optimization documents. The resulting dataset contains 10K high-quality SFT samples spanning four task categories and three problem representations. The specialized model achieves the highest average zero-shot Pass@1 score among the evaluated models, reaching 71.81% and outperforming GPT-5.4-Mini and the base DeepSeek-V4-Flash model by 3.98 and 11.27 percentage points, respectively. Overall, this work demonstrates a full-stack pathway from efficient trillion-parameter model post-training on Ascend infra to domain-specialized Flash models for solver-grounded mathematical modeling, advancing frontier-model systems for complex reasoning.
papers.summary: 本文报告了在昇腾NPU SuperPOD上对DeepSeek-V4系列万亿参数MoE模型进行全参数后训练的系统优化实践。针对内存压力、通信开销和内核执行效率等挑战，提出了一个分层优化框架，涵盖模型级并行、计算通信编排和底层内核执行。该系统实现了34.22%的MFU，相比开源基线提升2.93倍，同时保持训练稳定性。在此基础上，构建了面向运筹学（OR）任务的CPT和SFT工作流，开发了包含10K高质量SFT样本的数据集，覆盖四类任务和三种问题表示。微调后的DeepSeek-V4-Flash模型在零样本Pass@1上达到71.81%，优于GPT-5.4-Mini和基础模型。该工作展示了从高效后训练到领域专用模型的全栈路径。

papers.title: MERGE: Next-Generation Item Indexing Paradigm for Large-Scale Streaming Recommendation
papers.abstract: Item indexing, which maps a large corpus of items into compact discrete representations, is critical for both discriminative and generative recommender systems, yet existing Vector Quantization (VQ)-based approaches struggle with the highly skewed and non-stationary item distributions common in industrial streaming recommenders, leading to poor assignment accuracy, imbalanced cluster occupancy, and insufficient cluster separation. To address these challenges, we propose MERGE, a next-generation item indexing paradigm that adaptively constructs clusters from scratch, dynamically monitors cluster occupancy, and forms hierarchical index structures via fine-to-coarse merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MERGE significantly improves assignment accuracy, cluster uniformity, and cluster separation compared with existing indexing methods, while online A/B tests show substantial gains in key business metrics, highlighting its potential as a foundational indexing approach for large-scale recommendation. Codes are available at https://github.com/baiyimeng/MERGE.
papers.summary: MERGE提出了一种面向大规模流式推荐系统的下一代物品索引范式。现有基于向量量化（VQ）的方法在工业级流式推荐中面临物品分布高度倾斜和非平稳的挑战，导致分配精度低、簇占用不平衡和簇间分离不足。MERGE从零开始自适应构建簇，动态监控簇占用，并通过由细到粗的合并形成层次化索引结构。实验表明，MERGE在分配精度、簇均匀性和簇分离性上显著优于现有索引方法，在线A/B测试显示关键业务指标大幅提升。该工作为大规模推荐系统提供了一种基础性的索引方法，代码已开源。
papers.one_line_takeaway: MERGE通过自适应簇构建和层次化合并，解决了流式推荐中物品索引的分配不均和分布漂移问题，显著提升线上业务指标。
papers.core_method: MERGE的核心方法包括：1）从零开始自适应构建簇，不依赖预定义码本；2）动态监控簇占用，及时调整簇结构以应对非平稳分布；3）通过由细到粗的合并形成层次化索引，增强簇间分离性。

papers.title: Reinforced Attention Learning
papers.abstract: Post-training with Reinforcement Learning (RL) has substantially improved reasoning in Large Language Models (LLMs) via test-time scaling. However, extending this paradigm to Multimodal LLMs (MLLMs) through verbose rationales yields limited gains for perception and can even degrade performance. We propose Reinforced Attention Learning (RAL), a policy-gradient framework that directly optimizes internal attention distributions rather than output token sequences. By shifting optimization from what to generate to where to attend, RAL promotes effective information allocation and improved grounding in complex multimodal inputs. Experiments across diverse image and video benchmarks show consistent gains over GRPO and other baselines. We further introduce On-Policy Attention Distillation, demonstrating that transferring latent attention behaviors yields stronger cross-modal alignment than standard knowledge distillation. Our results position attention policies as a principled and general alternative for multimodal post-training.
categories: Generative Adversarial Networks and Image Synthesis
papers.summary: 本文提出强化注意力学习（RAL），一种直接优化多模态大语言模型（MLLM）内部注意力分布的策略梯度框架，而非传统的输出token序列。针对RL后训练在MLLM上通过冗长推理链提升有限甚至损害感知性能的问题，RAL将优化目标从“生成什么”转向“关注哪里”，促进有效信息分配和跨模态接地。实验在多种图像和视频基准上显示，RAL一致优于GRPO等基线。此外，引入在线策略注意力蒸馏，证明转移潜在注意力行为比标准知识蒸馏产生更强的跨模态对齐。结果表明注意力策略可作为多模态后训练的原则性通用替代方案。

papers.title: Evaluating the Effectiveness of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning in Genomic Classification Tasks
affiliations: Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory
papers.abstract: ABSTRACT Foundation models are increasingly being leveraged for biological tasks. To address the high memory requirements of fine-tuning large pre-trained language models, parameter efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) methods are also being increasingly utilized. Previous studies have shown minimal, if any, loss in performance when using PEFT on binary classification tasks. However, the impact of using PEFT on tasks with large classification spaces has not been systemically evaluated. In this work, we apply PEFT to the problem of taxonomic classification using pre-trained genomic language models as the classification backbone. We explore various training strategies—including PEFT, full fine-tuning, and partial fine-tuning—for classifying sequences at the superkingdom, phylum, and genus levels. We find that PEFT-trained models significantly underperform compared to those trained via full fine-tuning or partial fine-tuning. Additionally, we demonstrate increased performance of pretrained models over those randomly initialized.
papers.summary: 本文系统评估了参数高效微调（PEFT）在基因组分类任务中的有效性，特别是针对大分类空间（如超界、门、属）的场景。作者使用预训练基因组语言模型作为骨干，比较了PEFT、全量微调和部分微调三种策略。结果表明，PEFT在分类性能上显著低于全量微调和部分微调，而预训练模型优于随机初始化模型。研究揭示了PEFT在复杂分类任务中的局限性，为基因组学中模型微调策略的选择提供了实证依据。

papers.title: Mid-Training with Self-Generated Data Improves Reinforcement Learning in Language Models
papers.abstract: The effectiveness of Reinforcement Learning (RL) in Large Language Models (LLMs) depends on the nature and diversity of the data used before and during RL. In particular, reasoning problems can often be approached in multiple ways that rely on different forms of reasoning, and exposure to only a limited range of such approaches in the training data may limit the effectiveness of RL. Motivated by this, we investigate using diverse self-generated data during mid-training as an intermediate step before RL training. Specifically, we adopt a bootstrapped data-generation framework guided by George Polya's problem-solving approaches for generating multiple variants of correct answers for each question in the training data, and then perform fine-tuning. We first provide a theoretical perspective on how mid-training on such data improves RL and explain how policy-gradient updates can incentivize combining multiple approaches. We then empirically demonstrate that RL-trained models initialized with our mid-training data achieve consistent improvements across various mathematical reasoning benchmarks and other OOD tasks like code generation and narrative reasoning. Overall, our investigative study shows that a language model learning multiple problem-solving approaches, through self-generated data helps subsequent RL.
categories: Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare and Education
papers.summary: 本研究探讨了在强化学习（RL）训练之前，使用模型自生成的多风格数据作为中间训练（mid-training）步骤，以提升RL在数学推理等任务上的效果。作者基于Polya的问题解决理论，引导模型为每个问题生成多种正确解答变体，并在此数据上进行微调。理论上，他们分析了这种中间训练如何通过策略梯度更新激励模型组合多种推理路径。实验表明，在多个数学推理基准以及代码生成和叙事推理等OOD任务上，经过中间训练的模型在RL后均取得一致提升。研究强调，模型学习多种问题解决方式有助于后续RL的优化。

papers.title: See it to Place it: Evolving Macro Placements with Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: We propose using Vision-Language Models (VLMs) for macro placement in chip floorplanning, a complex optimization task that has recently shown promising advancements through machine learning methods. Because human designers rely heavily on spatial reasoning to arrange components on the chip canvas, we hypothesize that VLMs with strong visual reasoning abilities can effectively complement existing learning-based approaches. We introduce VeoPlace (Visual Evolutionary Optimization Placement), a novel framework that uses a VLM, without any fine-tuning, to guide the actions of a base placer by constraining them to subregions of the chip canvas. The VLM proposals are iteratively optimized through an evolutionary search strategy with respect to resulting placement quality. On open-source benchmarks, VeoPlace outperforms the best prior learning-based approach on 9 of 10 benchmarks with peak wirelength reductions exceeding 32%. We further demonstrate that VeoPlace generalizes to analytical placers, improving DREAMPlace performance on all 8 evaluated benchmarks with gains up to 4.3%. Our approach opens new possibilities for electronic design automation tools that leverage foundation models to solve complex physical design problems.
papers.summary: 本文提出VeoPlace框架，利用视觉语言模型（VLM）指导芯片宏布局优化。传统机器学习方法在布局任务中表现有限，而人类设计师依赖空间推理，因此作者假设VLM的视觉推理能力可辅助布局。VeoPlace无需微调VLM，通过进化搜索策略迭代优化VLM提出的布局区域约束，引导基础布局器（如DREAMPlace）在子区域内放置宏单元。在开源基准测试中，VeoPlace在10个基准中的9个上优于先前最佳学习方法，峰值线长减少超32%；在DREAMPlace上，8个基准全部提升，增益最高达4.3%。该方法展示了基础模型在电子设计自动化中的潜力。

papers.title: LEAP: Supercharging LLMs for Formal Mathematics with Agentic Frameworks
papers.abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit strong informal mathematical reasoning but struggle to generate mechanically verifiable proofs in formal languages like Lean. We present LEAP, an agentic framework that enables general-purpose foundation models to achieve state-of-the-art performance on automated formal theorem proving. LEAP leverages foundation model capabilities, such as informal reasoning, instruction following, and iterative self-refinement. By decomposing complex problems into smaller units, the system bridges formal proof construction with informal blueprints through continuous interaction with the Lean compiler. To provide a rigorous evaluation beyond increasingly saturated benchmarks, we introduce Lean-IMO-Bench, a benchmark of IMO-style problems formalized in Lean, with short statements yet highly non-routine and multi-step proofs across a wide range of difficulty levels. Empirically, on the latest 2025 Putnam Competition, an annual mathematics competition for undergraduate students in North America, LEAP solves all 12 problems, matching recent breakthroughs by frontier formal mathematical models. On Lean-IMO-Bench, LEAP boosts the one-shot formal solve rate of general-purpose LLMs from below 10% to 70%, notably surpassing the 48% benchmark set by a specialized, gold-medal-caliber IMO system. Furthermore, we demonstrate LEAP's research-level utility by autonomously formalizing complex proofs for open combinatorial challenges, including a verified proof for a key subproblem in Knuth's Hamiltonian decomposition of even-order Cayley graphs.
papers.summary: LEAP是一个智能体框架，旨在提升通用大语言模型在形式化数学定理证明中的表现。传统LLM在非正式数学推理上表现良好，但难以生成Lean等语言中可机械验证的证明。LEAP通过将复杂问题分解为更小的单元，并利用基础模型的非正式推理、指令遵循和迭代自我修正能力，与Lean编译器持续交互，桥接形式化证明构建与非正式蓝图。为严格评估，作者引入了Lean-IMO-Bench基准，包含IMO风格问题，语句简短但证明高度非例行且多步骤。实验表明，在2025年Putnam竞赛中，LEAP解决了全部12个问题，匹配前沿专用模型；在Lean-IMO-Bench上，将通用LLM的一次性形式化解决率从低于10%提升至70%，超过专业IMO系统的48%。此外，LEAP还自主形式化了Knuth关于偶数阶Cayley图哈密顿分解的关键子问题的验证证明，展示了研究级实用性。

papers.title: A framework for clinical validation of generative artificial intelligence therapeutics
papers.abstract: While established frameworks exist for assessing the clinical efficacy and effectiveness of human-delivered interventions, and standards are in place for pre-artificial intelligence (AI) chatbots that have achieved clearance from the US Food and Drug Administration (FDA) as companions to psychological treatment, a significant void remains. There are currently no defined standards to determine the efficacy of an AI agent in delivering validated treatment approaches, whether it is assisting with medication management, supporting clinicians, or directly delivering talk therapy. This gap leaves the field vulnerable, confronting a surge of emerging technologies without the necessary tools to ascertain their safety, and if – or for whom – they genuinely work. Autonomous or semi-autonomous AI agents, capable of interacting across diverse modalities – text, voice and images – can both understand and mirror the complex cues that human therapists utilize, thereby enhancing both engagement and assessment capabilities. This positions generative AI (GenAI) as a deeply promising solution for delivering psychological interventions, with the potential to significantly broaden treatment reach and reduce costs. However, the rapid proliferation of digital applications claiming therapeutic effects, coupled with their increasing adoption by the public1, underscores a crucial concern: the absence of established clinical standards for rigorously evaluating the safety and effectiveness of these GenAI agents. This regulatory void creates potential risks for patients and impedes the responsible and ethical integration of this transformative technology into validated clinical practice. Therefore, a robust evaluation framework, one that thoughtfully adapts established psychotherapy trial design principles to the unique characteristics of AI, is not only beneficial but urgently required. While sharing some commonalities with general wellness and coaching applications, GenAI agents explicitly intended for treatment of clinical disorders face distinct and amplified validation challenges. These encompass the intricate management of high-risk safety scenarios, the imperative for strict adherence to empirically supported therapeutic approaches, and the inherent complexities of clinical reasoning. Unlike traditional, deterministic chatbots that follow rigid decision trees, generative models operate probabilistically. Their dynamic, non-deterministic nature, while powerful, necessitates a novel dual approach to validation that seamlessly integrates meticulous human oversight with sophisticated agent-based evaluation, thereby ensuring uncompromised safety, efficacy and effectiveness. The concepts of efficacy (an intervention's effect under ideal conditions) and effectiveness (its performance in real-world settings) are foundational to therapeutic development. However, GenAI agents, with their dynamic, evolving models, directly challenge traditional validation paradigms. Their non-deterministic therapeutic actions mean that an agent may not produce identical responses to seemingly similar prompts. Consequently, the intervention cannot be defined by verbatim replication, but rather by the consistent and principled application of established therapeutic frameworks within clearly defined guardrails, much akin to how human-delivered treatments are evaluated for fidelity. Furthermore, the assumption that AI models can seamlessly mimic human clinical reasoning is inherently flawed. GenAI models are demonstrably prone to factual errors (often termed “hallucinations”), can inadvertently inherit biases embedded in their training data, and may exhibit deficits in episodic memory or subtle concept differentiation – all of which are critically important for sound clinical reasoning and avoiding problematic cognitions. Evaluating the cumulative impact of micro-interactions over extended periods is paramount, requiring analysis beyond simplistic single-turn benchmarks, to truly understand how an agent maintains therapeutic coherence, fosters an alliance, and effectively mitigates risks such as model sycophancy or the perpetuation of unhelpful thought patterns. Longitudinal studies, moreover, are particularly vulnerable to “model drift”, where updates to the underlying large language model (LLM) subtly alter the agent's therapeutic characteristics, necessitating rigorous version control and proactive clinical impact assessments. A particularly salient challenge, and potentially an opportunity, is the concept of the therapeutic alliance, which is an essential component of human-to-human treatment2, within human-AI interaction. Unlike humans, LLMs are not capable of complex cognitions that humans rely on to interact relationally3. Therefore, the nature of AI's alliance may rely on more concrete markers of trust and support – such as explicit goal-setting, the use of collaborative and validating language, and adaptive responsiveness. The “emotional bond” component, in this context, shifts from reciprocal human affection to the user's trust in the AI's consistency, reliability, helpfulness, and its demonstrated ability to deliver contextually appropriate and empathetic language. Evaluation, therefore, must involve analyzing the AI's dialogue for clear markers of active listening, validation, and empathetic resonance, alongside objective user interaction patterns such as sustained engagement and task adherence as robust behavioral proxies for a perceived positive alliance. To build patient confidence and ensure both safety and effectiveness, these core concepts must be rigorously adapted for GenAI. The efficacy of a GenAI therapeutic agent can be precisely defined as the capacity of a specific, version-controlled agent – meticulously characterized by its explicit model, knowledge grounding, therapeutic principles, and interaction protocols – to produce statistically and clinically significant improvement on validated primary outcome measures, relative to a robust control, in a randomly assigned population under optimized study conditions. This demands transparent documentation of the LLM version, fine-tuning data, and clearly defined guardrails4. Effectiveness is the extent to which an agent, deployed in representative real-world settings (including controlled updates), achieves clinically meaningful benefits across diverse outcome domains, demonstrates sustained user engagement, and consistently maintains an acceptable safety profile. Effectiveness studies therefore necessitate pragmatic designs that accurately reflect typical use-cases and heterogeneous populations, requiring robust strategies for managing model evolution through performance thresholds that trigger re-validation or continuous monitoring. To accelerate the responsible translation of GenAI into evidence-based mental health care, a multi-stage, hybrid validation process is essential, meticulously integrating rigorous technical AI evaluation with established clinical research methodologies. This comprehensive framework should be conceptualized in phases analogous to traditional therapeutic development: iterative development, pre-clinical validation, clinical trials, and post-deployment monitoring. The first phase, iterative development and benchmarking, involves rapid model refinement using simpler, initial benchmarks such as single-turn adherence checks. This phase focuses on foundational capabilities and preliminary alignment. The second phase, pre-clinical AI validation, moves beyond simple accuracy to rigorous in silico and simulated validation of the agent's behavior in complex, dynamic scenarios. This critical stage includes using LLM-to-LLM role-playing or human actors to simulate diverse therapeutic interactions, rigorous adversarial “red teaming” to proactively identify safety-critical failure modes5 (e.g., mismanaging crisis cues or providing harmful advice), and systematic bias and fairness audits to prevent the perpetuation or amplification of health disparities6. The third phase, clinical efficacy and effectiveness trials, establishes direct patient benefit. These demands validating longitudinal therapeutic coherence, as clinically relevant behaviors, therapeutic benefits, and potential risks often emerge and evolve over time. Trials must employ sophisticated methods to assess context retention, dialogue coherence, and task completion across extended, multi-session interactions. Human evaluation frameworks are paramount for assessing information quality, clinical reasoning, expression style, overall safety, and patient trust, alongside crucial ethical and practical considerations such as clinical credibility, user experience, user agency, equity, transparency, and crisis management protocols. The fourth phase, post-deployment and continuous validation, ensures sustained safety and efficacy in real-world use. GenAI agents require ongoing, vigilant monitoring to detect any performance degradation, drift, or the emergence of new risks. A one-time demonstration of effectiveness is insufficient for these rapidly evolving technologies. This phase demands pragmatic trial designs that accurately reflect real-world conditions7, clear and actionable protocols for re-validation when the underlying model is substantially updated or performance metrics fall below a pre-defined threshold, and robust continuous validation processes to re-establish therapeutic effects and comprehensively assess risk profiles. GenAI agents that interact directly with clinicians, caregivers and patients offer significant and transformative opportunities for psychotherapy. However, their responsible translation into validated clinical tools necessitates a clinically specific and robust research framework8, 9. The above-mentioned stages of development, which integrate traditional sequential clinical trial norms with emerging state-of-the-art AI validation strategies, provide a crucial path forward. The ultimate aim is to develop common standards and methodologies that facilitate unwavering transparency and engender deep trust across the entire ecosystem of mental health care.

papers.summary: 本文由Google DeepMind等机构的研究者提出，针对生成式AI（GenAI）在心理治疗等临床干预中的验证框架缺失问题，系统阐述了GenAI治疗剂的临床验证挑战与解决方案。文章指出，传统心理治疗疗效评估框架和FDA对预AI聊天机器人的标准均不适用于动态、非确定性的GenAI代理。作者定义了GenAI治疗剂的疗效与效果，强调版本控制、模型漂移、治疗联盟等特殊问题，并提出一个四阶段混合验证框架：迭代开发与基准测试、临床前AI验证（包括红队测试和偏见审计）、临床疗效与效果试验（关注纵向连贯性和人类评估）、部署后持续监控与再验证。该框架整合了传统临床试验原则与前沿AI验证策略，旨在建立通用标准，确保GenAI在精神卫生领域的安全、有效和负责任转化。
papers.one_line_takeaway: GenAI治疗剂需要一种融合传统临床试验与AI特有验证策略的四阶段混合框架，以应对其非确定性、模型漂移和治疗联盟等独特挑战。
papers.core_method: 提出四阶段混合验证框架：1) 迭代开发与基准测试（单轮依从性检查）；2) 临床前AI验证（LLM角色扮演模拟、对抗性红队测试、偏见与公平性审计）；3) 临床疗效与效果试验（纵向连贯性评估、人类评估框架）；4) 部署后持续验证（性能阈值触发再验证、持续监控）。
innovation_points: 首次为GenAI治疗剂定义了明确的疗效和效果概念，强调版本控制和治疗框架的忠实应用而非逐字复制。
提出将传统心理治疗试验设计原则与AI特有的验证方法（如红队测试、模型漂移管理）系统整合的四阶段框架。
针对治疗联盟概念，提出用具体信任标记（如目标设定、验证性语言）和用户行为代理（如持续参与）来评估人机联盟。

对模型漂移和再验证的触发条件缺乏量化标准。

papers.title: Moral Sensitivity in LLMs: A Tiered Evaluation of Contextual Bias via Behavioral Profiling and Mechanistic Interpretability
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in settings that require nuanced ethical reasoning, yet existing bias evaluations treat model outputs as simply "biased" or "unbiased." This binary framing misses the gradual, context-sensitive way bias actually emerges. We address this gap in two stages: behavioral profiling and mechanistic validation. In the behavioral stage, we introduce the Moral Sensitivity Index (MSI), a metric that quantifies the probability of biased output across a graduated, seven-tier stress test ranging from abstract numerical problems to scenarios rooted in historical and socioeconomic injustice. Evaluating four leading models (Claude 3.5, Qwen 3.5, Llama 3, and Gemini 1.5), we identify distinct behavioral signatures shaped by alignment design: for instance, Gemini 1.5 reaches 72.7% MSI by Tier 5 under socioeconomic framing, while Claude exhibits sharp suppression consistent with identity-based safety training. We then verify these behavioral patterns mechanistically. We select criminal-bias scenarios, which produced the highest MSI scores across models, as probes and apply logit lens, attention analysis, activation patching, and semantic probing to a controlled set of six models spanning three capability tiers: small language models (SLMs), instruction-tuned base models, and reasoning-distilled variants. Circuit-level analysis reveals a U-curve of bias: SLMs exhibit strong criminal bias; scaling to instruction-tuned models eliminates it; reasoning distillation reintroduces bias to SLM-like levels despite identical parameter counts, suggesting distillation compresses reasoning traces in ways that reactivate shallow statistical associations. Critically, the socially loaded cues that drive high MSI scores activate the same bias-driving circuits identified mechanistically, providing cross-stage validation.
